Title: Customer Success Manager
Description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.
  
  
As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.
  
  
The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, renewal, and expansion.
* Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
* Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce platform by:
* Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
* Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
* Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
* Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
* Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high-severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
* Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
* Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Experienced professional with 8+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
* Exceptional English & Arabic communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
* Skills for analyzing technical concepts, translating them into business terms, and mapping business requirements into technical features.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
* Knowledge of software development process and design methodologies.
* Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate the resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.
* **Fluency in both Arabic and English is essential**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* +2 years in the Salesforce Ecosystem.
* Salesforce product certifications are a plus ( **Administrator** , Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, **Service Cloud Consultant, Sales Cloud Consultant** ).
* Knowledge of Salesforce products and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy.
* Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. demonstrated behaviors in previous jobs, that align to role needs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Description:
We are committed to connecting Canadians through unique partnerships, our world-class network and content Canadians love—and our innovative team is growing. We are looking for dedicated team members to join our Corporate team who have a genuine passion for making positive impacts on customers and the communities where we live and work. The Marketing Operations Manager is responsible for the operational execution, governance, reporting, and optimization of marketing-generated leads and campaigns across Rogers Business. This role serves as a subject matter expert for Salesforce, lead management processes, campaign execution, reporting and analytics, and data governance.
  
  
Working cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Product, Digital, and Technology teams, the incumbent ensures that campaigns are successfully launched, leads are accurately managed and routed, reporting is reliable, and business stakeholders receive actionable insights to support revenue growth.
  
  
This position plays a critical role in supporting growth initiatives across Enterprise, SMB, Dealer/Partner, Retail, Digital, and Base programs while driving continuous improvement of lead management platforms, processes, and reporting capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Operations & Execution**

* Manage end-to-end campaign operations for marketing and sales programs.
* Support campaign intake, requirements gathering, prioritization, and execution planning.
* Coordinate campaign launches across multiple channels and business units.
* Ensure campaigns are executed accurately and on time.
* Support major revenue-generating initiatives including acquisition, upsell, cross-sell, retention, migration, serviceability, and partner programs.

**Salesforce Administration & Lead Management**

* Act as the business lead and subject matter expert for Lead Management within Salesforce.
* Maintain campaign structures, lead routing rules, ownership processes, and automation workflows.
* Design and implement process improvements that improve reporting accuracy and sales execution.
* Manage lead ownership governance.
* Support Salesforce enhancements, releases, testing, and adoption initiatives.
* Work closely with Sales Operations and Technology teams to improve CRM functionality and user experience.

**Data Governance & Quality Management**

* Establish and maintain standards for lead quality, campaign attribution, and Salesforce data integrity.
* Conduct data validation, cleansing, segmentation, and campaign readiness reviews.
* Manage lead distribution and assignment processes across multiple sales organizations.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues impacting campaign execution and reporting.

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to automate manual operational processes.
* Partner with business and technical teams to build scalable solutions using Salesforce, Power Automate, Revenue.io, and related technologies.
* Support business transformation initiatives focused on improving campaign execution efficiency.
* Document processes, create operating procedures, and maintain operational standards.

**Stakeholder Management & Enablement**

* Serve as the primary operational liaison between Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Technology, and Sales Operations teams.
* Train and support users on lead management processes, Salesforce functionality, and reporting tools.
* Influence business decisions through data-driven recommendations and operational expertise.

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 5+ years experience in Marketing Operations, CRM Operations, Sales Operations, Lead Management, or Business Analytics.
* Experience supporting national sales and marketing organizations.
* Experience managing complex campaigns within Salesforce environments.
* Experience developing business reporting and dashboard solutions.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Salesforce CRM knowledge.
* Strong understanding of lead lifecycle management and campaign attribution.
* Power BI reporting and dashboard development.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Marketing automation platform experience.
* Process automation experience (Power Automate, workflow tools, CRM automations).

**Key Success Metrics**

* Campaign launches delivered on time.
* Lead volume and quality targets achieved.
* Salesforce data quality and compliance standards maintained.
* Campaign conversion and opportunity creation performance.
* Reporting accuracy and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Reduction in manual processes through automation.
* Revenue contribution from supported campaigns.

Title: Senior Incident Response Manager, Public Safety
Description:
**Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.
  
  
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

**About Axon 911**
Axon 911 brings together Prepared and Carbyne under Axon. Together, we are creating the only platform that combines modern 911 infrastructure with an AI intelligence layer—helping public safety agencies move faster, make better decisions, and deliver better outcomes in the moments that matter most.
  
  
911 is the backbone of public safety, yet the professionals behind it have long been held back by outdated technology. Axon 911 is here to change that. Joining this team means more than taking a job—it means helping shape the future of emergency response and building a safer, more connected world.

**Your Impact**

At Axon 911, we are building mission-critical technology that supports emergency communications, public safety operations, and real-time response environments. We are seeking a Senior Service Delivery Manager, who will own the escalation lifecycle from intake to resolution, ensuring incidents are triaged accurately, prioritized based on operational and customer impact, assigned to the appropriate technical resources, and driven to closure with strong operational accountability and follow-through.
  
  
This is a founding role with high visibility and high impact, as this individual will serve as the operational lead during customer-impacting incidents, coordinating cross-functional response efforts across Software engineering, Operations and Customer Support resources.
  
  
The ideal candidate thrives under pressure, communicates with clarity and structure, and can confidently lead operational response efforts involving technical teams, executive stakeholders, and customer leadership.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and coordinate P1/P0 customer-impacting incidents across mission-critical SaaS environments
* Serve as Incident Commander during high-severity operational events and customer escalations
* Facilitate bridge calls and coordinate cross-functional response efforts across Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Support, NOC, and Customer teams
* Maintain clear, structured communication with both internal stakeholders and customer leadership teams, including executive-level audiences
* Drive operational accountability, incident timelines, action items, and follow-through during active incidents
* Lead post-incident reviews, root cause analysis discussions, after-action reporting, and operational improvement initiatives
* Partner closely with NOC and operational teams to support service continuity and platform reliability
* Help establish and mature incident management processes, workflows, tooling, and operational standards
* Participate in an on-call leadership rotation supporting critical customer incidents
* Travel up to 25% as needed to support customer operations, strategic initiatives, or critical incident response efforts

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of experience in Incident Management, Major Incident Management, Technical Operations, Escalation Management, NOC Operations, Service Reliability, or related operational leadership roles
* Experience leading high-severity operational incidents within SaaS, cloud, mission-critical, or highly available technical environments
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to remain calm, structured, and decisive during high-pressure situations
* Experience coordinating cross-functional technical teams during customer-impacting incidents
* Demonstrated ability to drive operational accountability and lead complex incident response efforts without direct authority
* Strong understanding of technical infrastructure concepts including cloud environments, networking, VoIP, SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations, and distributed systems
* Experience leading post-mortems, root cause analysis reviews, and operational improvement initiatives
* Comfortable operating within fast-paced, high-growth, and evolving environments
* Ability to participate in a heavy on-call rotation supporting mission-critical customer

**Nice-to-Haves:**

* Experience supporting mission-critical environments such as:

+ Public Safety
+ PSAP/ECC operations
+ Emergency Communications
+ NG911 environments
+ Critical Infrastructure
+ Real-Time Communications platforms

* Experience working with public safety technology vendors or operational environments
* Familiarity with CAD systems, call handling systems, emergency communications workflows, or incident command structures
* Experience supporting highly regulated or operationally sensitive customer environments
* Exposure to NIMS, ICS, APCO, ENP, or emergency communications operational frameworks
* Prior experience in public safety operations, emergency communications centers, or mission-critical command environments

**Work Location**

Team members in this position will follow a hybrid work model, which includes working onsite at a regional hub from Tuesday to Friday.

**Benefits that Benefit You**

* Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
* Discretionary paid time off
* Paid parental leave for all
* Medical, Dental, Vision plans
* Fitness Programs
* Emotional & Mental Wellness support
* Learning & Development programs
* And yes, we have snacks in our offices

*Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.*

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. * Large enterprises and multinational corporations
* Government and public-sector organizations
* Telecom operators
* Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI)
* Healthcare
* Retail and eCommerce
* Manufacturing

Title: Infrastructure Construction Manager
Description:
We are seeking an experienced **Infrastructure Construction Manager** to lead and oversee all on-site execution activities for large-scale civil and utility infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will manage site teams, subcontractors, equipment, and daily operations to ensure works—such as earthworks, roads, drainage, and wet/dry utilities—are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in strict compliance with quality and regulatory standards.Key Responsibilities

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering field.

* **Certifications:** PMP, NEBOSH/IOSH, or relevant local engineering registration/society membership is preferred.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong ability to read and interpret complex civil/utility drawings, familiarity with Primavera P6/MS Project schedules, and solid knowledge of construction methodologies.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:** Deep familiarity with local authority codes, utility standards, and traffic management/diversion protocols.

Title: AI & Technical Cybersecurity Standards Manager, Deloitte Global Technology
Description:

**Our Purpose**

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

By living our Purpose, we will make an impact that matters.

* Have many careers in one Firm.
* Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
* Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.

The AI & Technical Security Standards Manager leads the development, maintenance, and implementation of global cybersecurity standards covering artificial intelligence and other technically complex security domains. The role converts strategic, regulatory, risk, and engineering requirements into clear, practical, and measurable standards that can be adopted consistently across Deloitte Global.

This is a technically focused management role requiring sufficient depth to evaluate emerging technologies, challenge assumptions, and hold credible discussions with security architects, engineers, data scientists, AI specialists, risk professionals, and other subject matter experts. The successful candidate will balance technical rigor with clear policy writing, and sound judgement.

The role works across Cybersecurity, Technology, Risk, Privacy, Legal, and business teams to establish authoritative requirements, resolve complex standards questions, and support adoption. It also monitors developments in AI, cloud, software, infrastructure, and security engineering to ensure the standards portfolio remains relevant and forward-looking.

**Key Responsibilities**

***AI and technical security standards leadership***

* Own and manage the lifecycle (drafting, review, approval, publishing, maintenance) of Deloitte’s Global Cybersecurity policies and standards for AI and assigned technical security domains.
* Develop outcome-focused requirements that are technically credible, risk-based, and suitable for implementation across varied technology environments.
* Define security expectations for the design, development, acquisition, deployment, operation, and retirement of AI-enabled systems and supporting technology.
* Maintain new and revised standards, prioritized according to enterprise risk, regulatory change, technology adoption, and stakeholder need.
* Ensure AI-specific Deloitte Global Cybersecurity policies and standards are supported by clear guidance, control objectives, implementation considerations, and evidence expectations.

***Technical analysis and subject matter engagement***

* Lead detailed discussions with subject matter experts to understand technologies, threat scenarios, design constraints, and appropriate safeguards.
* Analyze architecture, engineering practices, threat intelligence, incidents, and control performance to identify where standards require clarification or enhancement.
* Translate complex technical concepts into concise requirements for technical and non-technical audiences without losing accuracy or intent.

**What will your typical day look like?**
-----------------------------------------

***AI security and emerging technology***

* Enhance Global Cybersecurity policies and standards for generative AI, machine learning, autonomous and agentic systems, AI platforms, models, data, integrations, and third-party AI services.
* Assess threats including prompt injection, insecure model and tool integration, sensitive data exposure, model manipulation, supply-chain compromise, excessive agency, and inadequate human oversight.
* Apply relevant industry and regulatory frameworks, including the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and OWASP guidance, while adapting requirements to the organization’s risk context.

***Standards governance and assurance***

* Manage consultation, review, approval, publication, exception, and periodic review processes in accordance with the Global Cybersecurity Policy and Standards governance framework.
* Define measures for standards adoption and effectiveness, and provide clear reporting on implementation progress, material gaps, exceptions, and emerging risks.
* Support assurance and control teams in interpreting standards, evaluating evidence, and distinguishing material risk from implementation variance.

***Team leadership and talent development***

* Provide inclusive, visible, and accountable leadership to analysts on the team, setting clear direction and translating strategic priorities into achievable objectives.
* Build team capability through regular coaching, mentoring, constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and meaningful development opportunities, while fostering collaboration, technical curiosity, and high professional standards.
* Align internal resources, external vendors, and specialist expertise to business priorities; establish clear roles, governance, decision rights, service expectations, and SLAs; monitor capacity, program performance, delivery quality, risks, and dependencies.
* Recognize strong contributions; and promote ownership, resilience, and continuous improvement so that the team consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.

***Risk, regulatory, and industry alignment***

* Monitor changes in laws, regulations, contractual obligations, threat patterns, and recognized frameworks that affect AI and technical security requirements.
* Map standards to internal controls and external frameworks to support traceability, assurance, and regulatory response.
* Provide risk-based advice on deviations and exceptions, ensuring decisions, compensating controls, ownership, and remediation commitments are appropriately documented.

***Stakeholder leadership and enablement***

* Build productive relationships with stakeholders (Deloitte Firm SMEs), security and technology leaders, architects, engineers, product teams and risk owners.
* Chair working groups and facilitate constructive technical challenges to achieve clear, proportionate, and implementable requirements.
* Produce briefings and decision materials that help teams understand both the requirement and the risk it addresses.

**About the team**
------------------

Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in "what is" but rather "what can be" to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.

**Enough about us, let’s talk about you**
-----------------------------------------

* Relevant experience demonstrating the technical depth, standards expertise, and stakeholder-management capability required for the role.

**Preferred:**

Our approach is grounded on recognizing people's unique strengths and contributions and rewarding the value that they deliver.  
  
Our Total Rewards Package extends well beyond traditional compensation and benefit programs and is designed to recognize employee contributions, encourage personal wellness, and support firm growth. Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Title: Manager, Application Support
Description:
**Who We Are**
As a leading Canadian wealth management organization, Richardson Wealth offers the personal touch of a boutique firm while delivering big results. With offices across the country, we are home to some of Canada’s best investment advisors. We’ve embarked on an exciting growth phase – a multi-year transformational journey to enhance our entrepreneurial, high-performing, advisor-centric culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Application Support Manager leads the team responsible for the health and support of Richardson Wealth’s business applications. The role oversees complex application support, incidents, escalations, operational readiness, service performance, and vendor support. The Manager actively participates in incident triage and prioritization, presents service health, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders, and demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills. Tier 2 owns technical diagnosis and service restoration, while permanent changes are transitioned to the appropriate delivery, data, infrastructure, security, or vendor team. The Manager also develops team capability and uses knowledge, automation, and AI responsibly to improve service quality and efficiency.
  
  
*This is an existing vacancy*
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* People Leadership & Capability: Lead, coach, and develop Tier 2 analysts and specialists; set clear accountabilities, establish coverage and succession plans, manage performance, and build cross-platform expertise.
* Production Service Health & Supportability: Own the operational health, stability, and supportability of assigned applications, integrations, batch processes, data feeds, and operational services. Use monitoring, observability, alerting, logs, and service telemetry to identify risks, service degradation, and emerging issues proactively.
* Incident Management: Ensure complex incidents are triaged, prioritized, investigated, resolved, documented, and communicated in accordance with agreed service-management practices and business-impact considerations. Coordinate root cause analysis (RCA) for significant or recurring incidents, ensuring corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and completed.
* Escalation Management: Lead the response to complex and high-impact issues by engaging and escalating to the appropriate vendors and internal teams. Ensure clear ownership, timely updates, effective hand-offs, and follow-through until service is restored and required corrective actions are completed.
* Operational Readiness: Assess the supportability of releases and production changes, confirming that monitoring, runbooks, support procedures, access, rollback plans, vendor contacts, knowledge transfer, and hypercare arrangements are in place before transition to operations. Delivery owns release content and implementation readiness; Tier 2 confirms operational readiness and ongoing supportability.
* Service Performance & Reporting: Establish and report meaningful service measures such as ticket ageing, priority trends, service-level performance, repeat incidents, backlog health, root-cause actions, vendor performance, and knowledge effectiveness. Use insights to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
* Knowledge Management & Shift Left: Build and maintain runbooks, known-error records, support procedures, and troubleshooting guidance. Partner with Business Support to move repeatable work to the lowest appropriate support level without transferring unresolved technical debt.
* Vendor & Third-Party Support: Manage operational support relationships with vendors, including case escalation, service reviews, defect follow-up, release impact, support obligations, and resolution of recurring service issues.
* Risk, Controls & Compliance: Ensure support activities follow change, security, privacy, access, audit, record-keeping, and regulatory control requirements appropriate to a wealth-management environment. Escalate material operational risks and control gaps.
* Operational Excellence, Automation & AI: Identify opportunities to improve support through automation, AI-assisted diagnostics, event correlation, ticket enrichment, knowledge retrieval, monitoring, recurring-task reduction, and reporting. Promote responsible use of AI with appropriate human oversight, data protection, validation, auditability, and control.
* Work Planning & Capacity: Balance reactive support, planned operational work, release support, problem remediation, and team development. Forecast capacity and raise trade-offs early when service resilience or delivery commitments are at risk.
* Business & Stakeholder Partnership: Build productive relationships with business, operations, compliance, delivery, and technology stakeholders; communicate clearly during incidents and provide transparent service-health, risk, and improvement updates.
* On-Call Support: Participate in and coordinate after-hours or weekend support when required for critical incidents, production releases, and time-sensitive operational activities.

**Qualifications**

* Post-secondary degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in support, production operations, service management, or a related technology field, including at least three years in a people-leadership or team-lead role.
* Experience leading complex incidents, technical escalations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and service improvements, supported by strong knowledge of ITIL-aligned service-management practices. ITIL certification is an asset.
* Strong technical knowledge of integrated enterprise application environments, including APIs, data feeds, batch processes, identity and access, databases, cloud or hosted services, and third-party platforms.
* Experience supporting operational readiness and production transitions, including monitoring, runbooks, rollback and hypercare planning, vendor coordination, and adherence to security, privacy, audit, resilience, and production-control requirements.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams on release planning, operational readiness, and continuous improvement.
* Strong people-management skills, including coaching, performance management, succession planning, and developing technical talent.
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify root causes, assess business impact, challenge incomplete information, and make risk-based recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver concise incident updates and explain technical issues, risks, and trade-offs to business and executive stakeholders.
* Experience in wealth management, financial services, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accountability, sound judgement, customer focus, and attention to detail.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and French is an asset.

**Why Apply**

Title: Technical Account Manager - Openshift (Remote, Doha with French)
Description:
Red Hat's Technical Services team is looking for an experienced, enterprise-level engineer to join us as a OpenShift Technical Account Manager (TAM).

In this role, you'll work with a small set of key customers to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance for the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform.

At Red Hat, customer support includes far more than just “break-fix” solutions. Customers get industry-leading resources that enable their technical environments to run efficiently, so they can focus on growing their businesses.

Technical account management is a premium support offering that builds, maintains, and grows long-lasting customer loyalty between Red Hat and our customers.

You will forge relationships with your customers, develop a deep technical understanding of their Red Hat implementation, share technical best practices and act as point of contact for any major incidents, managing the customer’s expectations and communications through resolution of such incidents.

You will tailor support for each customer's environment, facilitate collaboration with their other vendors and advocate on their behalf. At the same time, you'll work closely with our Engineering, Research and Development, Product Management, and Global Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues.

The ideal TAM is a team player, enjoys working hard, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, building relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, is able to learn new technologies quickly and uses their time efficiently.

**What you will do:**

  

* Develop relationships with key business and IT stakeholders and become an expert on a customer’s implementation by understanding their top business goals and priorities.
* Perform technical reviews and share knowledge to proactively identify and prevent issues
* Forewarn customers of technology changes or potential disruptions to their service and advice on mitigation strategies.
* Provide advice and guidance to customers about their current and future Red Hat products;
* Troubleshoot technical issues and drive issue escalation with Red Hat and customer teams
* Complete analysis and present periodic reviews of operational performance to customer leadership
* Manage customer use cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans and keep the documentation on the customer's environment updated
* Manage and grow customer relationships by delivering attentive, relationship-based support
* Build a sense of trust with customers and serve as their advocate within Red Hat
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas
* Partner closely with Red Hat Engineering, Product Management, and Technical Support teams to debug, test, and resolve issues
* Travel, as necessary, to visit customers and attend events within the region
* Learn new technologies quickly, including topics like container orchestration, container registries, container build strategies, and microservices on container platforms
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat cloud technologies strategy
* Engage with Red Hat’s product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns, based on customer engagements, as well as personal experience, that drive platform adoption
* Engage with Red Hat’s field teams, customers, and partners to ensure a positive cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat cloud solutions and our cloud roadmap align to customer use cases

**What you will bring:**

* **5 years experience in a support, development, engineering, or quality assurance** organisation
* Expertise with enterprise cloud solutions like **Platform-as-a-Service** **(OpenShift by Red Hat), containers, Kubernetes**, **cloud management**, and **IT automation** (Ansible Automation Platform by Red Hat)
* Ability to manage and grow existing enterprise customer relationships by delivering proactive, relationship-based support
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills; ability to convey complex information to customers clearly and concisely
* Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers
* Ability to manage multiple issues and projects with an eye for detail
* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors
* Good verbal and written communication skills in French

**The following are considered a plus:**

* Experience in system management, cloud or server virtualization
* Bachelor's degree in a technology-related discipline, preferably computer science or engineering
* **Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)**
* Prior experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role
* Experience with training and presentation delivery

**About Red Hat**

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

**Inclusion at Red Hat**  
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Title: Senior Business Dvelopment Manager (WhatsApp, Chatbots)
Description:
**Type:** Permanent role, Full time  
**Location:** Saudi Arabia, Riyadh, 100% onsite  
**Salary:** Fixed plus variable (Depending on experience)

**About CEQUENS**

CEQUENS is a leading cloud communication platform in the Middle East and Africa region and is dedicated to simplifying communications and building bridges to allow businesses to communicate with their customers, no matter where they are. The company provides Omni-Channel communication API’s enabling enterprises and developers to communicate with their

Our partner network covers MEA region with international access to messaging hubs worldwide and our clients include major banks, credit cards, digital payments, OTT applications, government authorities, health and education, and other industry verticals.

If you have the passion for success and are ready to constantly challenge yourself within a collaborative team-environment join our team.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Senior Business Development Manager to drive revenue growth in Saudi Arabia by winning new customers and developing a strong partner ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of selling SaaS/CPaaS solutions, specifically **AI agents, AI-powered chatbots and WhatsApp automation platforms**, to businesses looking to improve sales performance, customer engagement, and customer support.

This is a hands-on, targeted sales role as single contributor, reporting in the Sales Manager. We are looking for someone who understands how to sell subscription-based software, can confidently lead their own product demonstrations, manage a sales pipeline and close deals. There will some travel involved to clients site in Riyadh and other location in Saudi Arabia,

Importantly, we want someone who has sold a similar product before, rather than someone coming purely from traditional software or IT services sales.

Alongside direct sales, the successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, recruiting, and managing channel partners who can resell or refer our platform, including digital agencies, system integrators, resellers and technology partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Business Development & Direct Sales**

* Own an deliver an individual new business sales target across the Saudi Arabian market.
* Identify, prospect and win new customers for our AI agent and chatbot platform
* Sell subscription-based software solutions to businesses across relevant sectors.
* Build relationships with senior decision-makers, including CEOs, Commercial Directors, Heads of Sales, Marketing Directors and Customer Experience leaders.
* Understand customer requirements and demonstrate how AI agents and WhatsApp automation can improve sales conversion, customer engagement and support efficiency.
* Personally deliver compelling product demonstrations, showing prospective customers the platform's capabilities and commercial value.
* Manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through demonstrations, proposals, negotiation and closing.
* Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline, accurately forecasting opportunities and revenue.
* Consistently achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.

**Partnerships & Channel Development**

* Identify and recruit suitable channel partners across Saudi Arabia
* Build relationships with digital and marketing agencies, system integrators, software resellers and technology partners.
* Develop partner propositions that encourage third parties to refer or resell the platform.
* Onboard, train and enable partners to confidently position, demonstrate and sell the solution.
* Establish partner commercial agreements, referral arrangements and reseller models.
* Actively manage partner relationships, ensuring partners generate qualified opportunities and contribute to revenue growth.
* Develop a scalable partner ecosystem that supports market penetration and long-term recurring revenue.

**Market Development**

* Develop a strong understanding of the Saudi Arabian market for AI-powered customer engagement and conversational commerce.
* Identify target industries and businesses with strong demand for WhatsApp automation, AI sales agents and customer service solutions.
* Monitor competitor offerings, market trends and emerging opportunities.
* Develop effective go-to-market approaches to accelerate customer acquisition.
* Represent the business at relevant industry events, networking opportunities and customer meetings.

  
**Requirements**

We are specifically looking for candidates with experience selling products similar to ours.

The ideal candidate will have:

* **Proven SaaS/CPaaS sales experience:** A strong track record of selling subscription-based software, ideally with recurring monthly or annual revenue models.
* **Relevant product experience:** 4 years plus experience of selling WhatsApp Business, automation platforms, AI agents, AI-powered chatbots or conversational AI software.
* **Quota-carrying experience:** Personally owned and delivered against a new business sales target, with demonstrable success in winning new customers.
* **Product demonstration skills:** Confident delivering their own software demonstrations and presenting product capabilities to prospective customers.
* **Full sales cycle experience:** Comfortable managing opportunities from initial prospecting through to commercial negotiation and closing.
* **Partnership development:** Experience recruiting, onboarding and managing partners who resell or refer software products.
* **Commercial acumen:** Able to articulate the business case, ROI and commercial benefits of AI-powered customer engagement solutions.
* **Relationship-building skills:** Confident engaging with senior business stakeholders and decision-makers.
* **Market knowledge:** Good understanding of the Saudi Arabian business environment and B2B technology sales landscape.

**Particularly Relevant Backgrounds**

* We are interested in candidates who have worked for businesses selling products in areas such as:
* WhatsApp Business API platforms and WhatsApp automation software.
* AI-powered sales agents and customer service agents.
* Conversational AI and chatbot platforms.
* Customer engagement and messaging automation SaaS.
* AI-powered customer experience and contact centre solutions.
* Omnichannel customer communication platforms.
* Candidates who have sold comparable subscription-based products and have personally managed their own sales targets will be particularly attractive.

**The Ideal Candidate**

* You are a commercially minded, self-starting sales professional who knows how to sell SaaS products and understands the opportunity in AI-powered customer engagement.
* You are not simply an account manager or relationship builder. You are a proven new business hunter who carries a number, creates opportunities, delivers demonstrations and closes deals.
* You understand how to sell the value of AI agents and chatbots to businesses, particularly where WhatsApp is a key customer communication and sales channel.
* You also understand the value of building a partner ecosystem and have experience turning agencies, resellers and technology partners into productive sales channels.
* Most importantly, you have sold something similar before, know how to win customers and can demonstrate a track record of delivering commercial results.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Title: Business Development Manager - Saudi National
Description:
**Business Development Manager - Saudi National**  
**Impact a better future**

At **Serco**, we bring together the right people, technology, and partners to deliver innovative solutions that impact a better future.

We have been operating in the Middle East since 1947 and have a profound understanding of the region.

With over 4,500 colleagues here, we support governments across defence, space, transport, emergency services, justice and migration, and other vital public services. Our core capabilities span service design and advisory, customer experience, complex programme management, systems integration, and asset and facilities management, alongside environmental and case management services.

Guided by our unique service model, we work together with clients and partners to achieve long-term visions and tackle some of the world’s most complex challenges.

**Your Opportunity**

The **Business Development Manager** is responsible for delivering new business revenue and converting opportunities in these sectors across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Working under the direction of the Chief Growth Officer, the role drives pipeline development, builds and maintains client relationships and leads the sales effort on assigned opportunities and accounts, supporting Serco's positioning as a trusted, high-quality partner in delivering Vision 2030 priorities.

The role works side by side with the Business Development and Advisory teams, combining personal origination and account management with close collaboration on propositions, bids and the client engagement programme. It targets ministries, government entities, PIF-backed organisations, giga-projects and national energy, defence and space players, converting opportunities into sustainable revenue and operational growth.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Sales Delivery and Revenue Growth**

* Accountable for delivering assigned new business revenue and profit targets across the government, energy, defence and space sectors in the KSA, through personal origination, account growth and pipeline conversion.
* Execute the sector sales plan agreed with the Sales Director, covering government services, ministries, PIF and giga-projects, energy (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables and energy transition), defence and space.
* Build and maintain a qualified, high-quality pipeline that meets short- and long-term growth ambitions, with accurate pipeline data maintained in MS Dynamics.
* Use market analysis and intelligence, shared with the Business Development and Advisory teams, to identify target clients, emerging trends, competitor activity and whitespace aligned to Vision 2030 priorities.
* Track and report on pipeline, forecast and conversion performance, escalating risks to targets to the Sales Director.

**Client Access and Relationship Development**

* Own relationships with assigned clients at senior level across ministries, government agencies, PIF entities, giga-projects and energy, defence and space organisations, escalating strategic and executive-level engagement to the Sales Director.
* Build and sustain a network of clients, partners and key stakeholders across the target sectors.
* Engage clients early in their decision-making cycle to understand requirements and position Serco's solutions.
* Implement the structured Client Engagement Programme and maintain account plans for assigned major customers, in line with the framework set by the Sales Director.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, working with the Advisory team to offer insight that leads to repeat business.

**Commercial Support and Negotiation**

* Lead commercial negotiations on assigned opportunities within delegated authority, escalating major or strategic negotiations to the Sales Director and General Manager – KSA.
* Contribute to the structuring of contracts, partnerships and joint ventures, working with Commercial and Finance colleagues to ensure commercial robustness.
* Maintain awareness of pricing, margin performance, risk allocation and contract terms to support profitable, sustainable growth.
* Balance client needs, delivery credibility and commercial outcomes when closing opportunities.

**Propositions and Joint Working**

* Work alongside the Business Development and Advisory teams to shape government, energy, defence and space propositions, bringing client insight and helping validate market need and competitor positioning.
* Contribute to joint propositions and commercial models, including local partnerships and strategic supplier relationships, that showcase end-to-end solutions.
* Support go-to-market activity, including customer segmentation, sales analytics and the packaging of propositions with marketing experts.
* Work with the Advisory team to create an advisory-to-operations pathway that unlocks downstream implementation and long-term contract opportunities.
* Share client feedback and market insight to strengthen Serco's existing unique selling propositions and inform new products and service offerings.

**Bid Support**

* Work closely with the Bidding team to ensure timely, high-quality submissions for all targeted opportunities.
* Lead the sales input to bids on assigned opportunities, ensuring a persuasive, commercially competitive offering that fully reflects customer requirements.
* Guide assigned bids through Serco's internal governance and approval process, with the support of the Bidding team and the Sales Director.
* Understand local laws, public procurement processes and government buying environments in the KSA.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Representation**

* Advocate for Serco externally and internally at a senior level, representing the Sales Director where required.
* Pitch Serco's capabilities and deliver value propositions against client requirements through high-quality presentations and proposals.
* Represent Serco at industry conferences, trade shows and networking events in KSA.
* Work with colleagues to share operational good practice, exploit synergies and promote cross-selling across sectors and business units.

**Team Contribution, Reporting and Compliance**

* Support and guide junior sales and business development colleagues, and contribute to the development of local talent in line with Saudization and capability-building objectives.
* Act as sales sponsor on assigned accounts, working with Operations to ensure quality, client satisfaction and measurable outcomes.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activity and provide regular updates to the Sales Director and senior management.
* Ensure compliance with local laws, regulations and cultural considerations in KSA, and contribute to Serco-wide corporate governance and good practice.

**Specific Requirements**

* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience and an established network across Saudi government, semi government organisations, PIF companies and major infrastructure operators.
* Demonstrable experience working with government entities, ministries, giga-projects, sovereign-backed organisations and/or PIF-related environments.
* Experience in the energy sector (oil and gas, power and utilities, renewables or energy services), with a network among key energy-sector stakeholders.
* Exposure to the defence and space sectors, including engagement with defence and space entities, programmes and partners.
* Proven track record of originating and closing complex opportunities and delivering significant annual revenue in government services, consulting or related sectors.
* Experience contributing to commercial negotiations, including strategic partnerships, JVs and multi-stakeholder opportunities.
* Bidding and commercial experience on large, complex business opportunities.
* Good understanding of the Saudi business and government landscape, Vision 2030 priorities, and national transformation programmes and investment themes.
* Experience navigating public procurement and relationship-led market development.
* Familiarity with PIF ecosystem dynamics, giga-project stakeholder structures and local partnership models.
* Appreciation of localization, Saudization and in-Kingdom value creation expectations, with high cultural awareness.

**Join Us**

At Serco, we believe there is a place here for everyone. A place where you can bring your authentic self to work every day. Our workplace culture is one that embraces diversity and fosters equity, respect, and belonging for every individual. We are committed to equal employment opportunities and creating an inclusive environment that proudly celebrates the perspectives and backgrounds that each of our employees bring to work every day.

Join Serco and be part of a values-driven organization that invests in the development and well-being of its employees and offers a rewarding and fulfilling career.

Serco is committed to Equal Employment Opportunities and is committed to ensuring the safety of all of its employees through its Zero Harm initiative. Please visit **careers.serco.com** for more information.

**Location:**
PCS CA~TORONTO
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
10-15 Years
  
  
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Support Lead to oversee and manage 24/7 production support operations for critical digital assets, tokenized deposits, stablecoin processing, and blockchain-enabled payment infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, DLT node health, rapid incident resolution, and strict SLA adherence across multi-tiered financial and tokenization platforms.

* Lead day-to-day production support operations, incident management, and problem management processes for tokenized deposit and payment platforms.
* Serve as the primary point of escalation for high-priority production incidents (P1/P2) involving token issuance, wallet custody integrations, or smart contract workflows.
* Oversee SLA compliance, transaction failure tracking, root cause analysis (RCA), and remediation for tokenized asset platforms.
* Manage shift handovers, on-call support rotas, and cross-location support coordination between onshore and offshore teams for high-availability payment networks.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in production/application support within Banking, Digital Payments, or Financial Technology domains.
* Hands-on background or strong working knowledge of tokenized deposits, digital asset operating models, stablecoins, or DLT/blockchain platforms.
* Proficiency with SQL, Unix/Linux shell scripting, and enterprise APM/logging tools (e.g., Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, Datadog).
* Strong ITIL process mastery (Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management).

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with digital wallet architectures, custody solutions, and cross-border payment messaging (e.g., ISO 20022, SWIFT).
* Understanding of cloud-hosted infrastructure (AWS/Azure) and containerized service monitoring (Docker/Kubernetes).
* Excellent crisis management, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* ITIL Foundation or blockchain/fintech certifications are a plus.

Title: Manager, Technology Audit
Description:
Job Description:

Referral Level: Level 1

Location: Toronto/Winnipeg

**Mackenzie Investments**

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Mackenzie Investments, founded in 1967, is a key part of IGM's business model, serving as a comprehensive asset-management partner for Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

**At Mackenzie Investments, we believe being invested starts with our people.** We are proud to be recognized as one of Canada’s Top 100 Employers for the fourth consecutive year and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. Our vision and strategy aim to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

**Role Overview**  
The Manager, IT Audit reports to the Director, IT Audit and is responsible for planning and executing risk-based technology audit and advisory engagements. This role focuses on assessing risks and controls across cloud environments, DevSecOps practices, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, and enterprise technology platforms. The successful candidate will work closely with technology and business stakeholders to provide practical, risk-based recommendations that strengthen governance, risk management, and control processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Leverage AI and analytics tools to improve audit efficiency, risk assessment, testing methodologies, and reporting processes.
* Assess governance and controls over AI and machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, monitoring, explainability, accountability, bias management, and data governance.
* Develop and execute data-enabled audit approaches using analytics, visualization, automation, and continuous auditing techniques.
* Assess risks associated with generative AI technologies, large language models, agentic systems, and third-party AI services.
* Lead and execute technology audit engagements from planning through reporting.
* Perform audits of cloud environments, including governance, security, identity and access management, resilience, and third-party risk controls.
* Assess DevSecOps processes, CI/CD pipelines, secure software development practices, and deployment controls.
* Evaluate governance, risk management, security, privacy, and regulatory considerations associated with AI solutions and emerging technologies.
* Assess IT general controls, automated controls, application controls, and cybersecurity controls.
* Participate in audits of major technology transformation initiatives, cloud migrations, and digital programs.
* Support integrated audits by identifying technology risks that may impact business processes.
* Develop clear and concise audit findings and recommendations.
* Build effective relationships with technology, cybersecurity, risk management, and business stakeholders.
* Monitor emerging risks and industry trends related to cloud computing, AI, cyber security, and software engineering.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across audit methodologies, quality assurance processes, audit technology, and reporting practices.
* Act as a trusted advisor to technology leadership on risk, governance, and control matters.
* Provide guidance and coaching to junior auditors and co-op students where applicable.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong understanding of technology risk management and control frameworks including NIST, COBIT, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Hands-on experience auditing cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience reviewing DevSecOps environments, Agile delivery practices, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle controls.

* Experience using data analytics and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Diligent/ ACL, Python, SQL, Databricks, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding AI governance, AI model risks, data quality, privacy, explainability, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience with scripting, automation, or audit technology solutions to improve assurance effectiveness.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including identity and access management, vulnerability management, logging and monitoring, and incident response.

**Professional Experience**  

* 5-8 years of experience in IT audit, technology risk, cybersecurity, data analytics, or related assurance functions, with demonstrated experience leading complex audit engagements.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, wealth management, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Experience working with cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, and AI-related risks is required.

**Education and Certifications**

**Mandatory Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) or CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

**Preferred / Optional Certifications**  

* CPA (Certified Professional Accountant) or CIA (Certified Internal Auditor)

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification.
* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager).  
  + CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional).
  + Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert or Azure Security Engineer Associate.
  + ISACA Advanced in AI Audit (AAIA) or equivalent AI audit certification.

**Leadership and Competencies**  

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

**Additional Information**  

* Hybrid work model (3 days in office per week).
* Occasional travel may be required.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $86,000 - $123,000 which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

**Benefits*****:***

* **COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION:** competitive base salary, performance-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
* **EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE:** competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
* **RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS:** voluntary Group RRSP enrolment with employer matching component.
* **WORK LIFE BALANCE:** paid volunteer days, competitive time off including 10 wellness days off, WorkPerks discount program, hybrid & flex work arrangements.
* **INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY:** living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! We encourage applications from all qualified candidates that represent the diversity present across Canada – including racialized persons, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender diverse and neurodiverse individuals, as well as all who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

Mackenzie Investments is an accessible employer committed to providing barrier-free recruitment experience. If you require accommodation or this information in an alternate format at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team who will work with you to meet your needs.

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience to **https://www.mackenzieinvestments.com/en/careers**.

**Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment:** As part of our Talent Acquisition process, we may use artificial intelligence and automated tools to support activities such as candidate sourcing, application review, and interview scheduling. These tools support the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by people.

We thank all applicants for their interest in Mackenzie Investments; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please apply by December 1 2026.

* Experience managing data platforms as a product.
* Experience with implementing end-to-end scalable solutions in the cloud.

Title: Program Director
Description:
The Program Director is responsible for working in collaboration with other program staff to oversee all aspects of service delivery for the following:

* Older American Act/Senior Community Services: Aging and Disability Resource Center (Options, Benefits, Specialized Information and Assistance, Kinship); Escorted Transportation; Homemaker; Restaurant Voucher;
* Nutrition Services: Food Pantry, Commodity and Senior Food Boxes;

**Duties Include:**

Under the supervision of the Executive Director

* Manage Senior Community Services, Nutrition Services, and Safe at Home, ensuring all services are provided in accordance with applicable funder requirements and federal, state and local laws and health requirements.

* In collaboration with other LCOOA service providers, direct and manage care to at-risk older adults who are eligible to receive Lorain County Office on Aging’s Senior Community Services, Nutrition Services, and/or Safe at Home.

* Ensure screen and holistically assessment of individuals (60+) referred to Senior Community Services to determine their eligibility for all Agency services and make referrals as appropriate.

* Maintain program waiting list(s); communicate program availability to case management staff.

* Ensure the scheduling of all Homemaker and Escorted Transportation Services provided by LCOOA.

* Train, supervise, and evaluate staff, volunteers and interns, as assigned; to include, but not limited to, Nutrition Services Coordinator, Safe at Home Coordinator, Transportation Coordinator, ADRC/SSO Coordinator

* Conduct at least monthly supervisory visits with direct reports. Resolve complaints and interpersonal issues between Staff and clients, clarifying guidelines as necessary.

* Conduct monthly department meetings with Senior Community Services/ADRC/OAA staff.

* Maintain discipline, morale, harmonious personnel relations and handle complaints in accordance with Agency policy and procedure; make recommendations to the Executive Director for transfers, promotions and/or terminations.

* Maintain availability for direct reports as necessary to address urgent concerns related to clients or for scheduling difficulties unable to be resolved during normal work hours.

* Ensure that all applicable assessments, 90-day care plan reviews and annual re-assessments are completed for all enrolled clients in Senior Community Services, Nutrition Services, and Safe at Home in accordance with WRAAA rules, Ohio Administrative Code, and other applicable funder requirements.

* Work collaboratively with the Executive Director, to address client incidents, complaints or recurring concerns.

* Ensure client files, including service sheets, information obtained during supervisory meetings, telephone calls with clients, and in-home visits are being maintained by staff as appropriate. Complete accurate and up-to-date client documentation and records that are in compliance with all regulatory and funding requirements, including WRAAA, Ohio Administrative Code, and other applicable funders.

* Develop/update client guidelines for programs. Create forms for use with programs.

* Participate in program audits and site visits, as needed.

* In conjunction with Executive Director and Director of Operations, conduct evaluations of services, to determine effectiveness, efficiency and satisfaction with all services offered in the programs managed.

* Provide administrative and outreach support as necessary.

* All other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications:**

Program Director must have one or more of the following qualifications, in accordance with OAC 173-3-06.4:

* Have a BS or BA in a health and human services field or
* Has completed at least two years of professional experience
* Master’s Degree in Social Work with LSW licensure preferred.

Proficient with a computer, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Internet and Email.

Able to complete and pass a criminal background check, at hire and every 5 years, including a BCII/FBI criminal background check.

Dependable transportation with proof of valid driver’s license and insurance.

Able to work independently, be flexible, manage multiple priorities, meet tight deadlines.

Proven experience as an effective team player.

Excellent time management and communication skills.

Experience in working effectively with persons of diverse racial, ethnic, age, gender, religion, disability and socioeconomic backgrounds.

Prefer experience or working knowledge of older adult populations in Lorain County and the resources and services available to meet the needs of older adults.

Benefits:

* Paid time off
