Title: eTrading Engineering Lead
Description:
In compliance with applicable laws, HSBC is committed to employing only those who are authorized to work in Canada. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada as HSBC will not engage in immigration sponsorship for this position.
  
  
In Canada, HSBC Global Services (Canada) Limited (HGCA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Global Services Limited. Operating in Toronto, HGCA is part of a global service company, delivering services to support the operating entities of HSBC Group. We have different capabilities that provide tools and processes to facilitate the functions, business, and entities with their service management responsibilities.
  
  
**Ready to shape the infrastructure behind low-latency electronic trading platforms?**
**Why HSBC**
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join Markets and Securities Services Information Technology (IT) as Regional Head of electronic Trading (eTrading) Infrastructure Engineering in Toronto, Canada. This role owns the regional infrastructure engineering capability supporting latency-sensitive and collocated electronic trading platforms. You’ll manage two infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on across data center compute, Linux, server hardware, network switching, and exchange connectivity. You’ll take end-to-end accountability for the regional infrastructure delivery pipeline aligned to agreed business priorities, alongside operational service performance and the regional risk and control agenda. Success means resilient, secure, and cost-effective services, strong control outcomes, and well-governed delivery across collocated data centers and exchange-facing infrastructure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Oversee and develop two infrastructure engineers, setting objectives, allocating work, and building succession and capability plans
* Own the regional delivery pipeline and roadmap, translating business priorities into committed plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes while managing dependencies and trade-offs
* Manage the regional infrastructure budget, forecasts, and investment cases, controlling capital and operating expenditure and supplier and hardware lifecycle decisions
* Govern service availability, capacity, resilience, and support readiness, coordinating incident, problem, change, and recovery through to permanent remediation
* Own the regional risk and control environment, including technology risk assessment, audit and regulatory actions, security and firmware compliance, evidence quality, and timely issue closure
* Design, build, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure across collocated and enterprise data centers including Linux platforms, physical servers, network switches, cabling, out-of-band management, and low-latency connectivity
* Define and maintain regional reference architectures, engineering standards, design blueprints, build patterns, and operational procedures aligned with global strategy
* Build repeatable infrastructure delivery and validation pipelines using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing, contributing production-quality Java and Ansible code
* Stakeholder management: Partner with trading business, application engineering, architecture, cyber security, operations, risk, finance, procurement, vendors, exchanges and carriers to deliver regional outcomes.
* Regional execution: Lead data-centre builds, migrations, refreshes and exchange onboarding, coordinating suppliers and remote-hands teams and providing hands-on support during critical implementations and incidents.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial hands-on experience in infrastructure, network, or compute engineering with accountability for regional or business-critical services
* Manage a small engineering team, establishing priorities, assuring delivery, and developing technical capability
* Own budgets, forecasts, vendors, operational performance, and technology risk and control obligations
* Apply deep expertise across Linux, enterprise server hardware, data center and colocation environments, network switches, and physical infrastructure lifecycle management
* Use strong knowledge of low-latency networking including Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing and switching, multicast, packet capture analysis, and exchange or market data connectivity
* Build continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows and automated, version-controlled infrastructure delivery aligned to a Network Development and Operations (NetDevOps) approach
* Apply Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to infrastructure and network engineering using repeatable lab and pre-production validation
* Write production code in Java, or bring equivalent demonstrable production coding experience in Python or a comparable language
* Build Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible including reusable roles and playbooks, automated testing, and integration into delivery pipelines
* Experience supporting electronic trading, market-data or other latency-sensitive financial services infrastructure.
* Professional network certification such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center, or equivalent depth of experience.
* Experience with Docker, Containerlab, Molecule, Jira, Confluence and CI platforms such as TeamCity.

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!
  
  
The final fixed pay offer will depend on the candidate and a number of variables, including but not limited to, role responsibilities, skill set, depth of experience and education, licensing/certification requirements, internal relativity, and specific work location.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, race, national origin, ethnicity, disability or medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran service, religion, creed, sex, gender, pregnancy, childbirth, caregiver status, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or any other trait protected by applicable law.

Title: Manager, Brand Technology Production Support

**Production Support Manager - 12mth Contract**
The Marketing and Brand Technology and Implementation Team is looking for a
**Production Support Manager**
to lead end-to-end production support, service reliability, and maintenance across Loblaw Brands technology systems. The role is accountable for incident resolution, service stability, data integrity, operational readiness, and continuous improvement, while partnering with technology, business, and vendor teams to minimize business disruption
  
  
What makes this opportunity outstanding? At Loblaws Inc., we are committed to crafting a flawless, world-class technology environment. This role offers the chance to work with exceptionally talented teams and collaborate across various functions to ensure our technology systems excel at the highest level. The Production Support Manager will help strengthen service resilience through proactive monitoring, operational discipline, automation, and measurable continuous improvement.
  
  
Reporting into the Senior Technology and Implementation Manager, the Production Support Manager will be responsible for:
  
  

* Oversee daily production support operations for Loblaw Brands Technology Systems; own or coordinate resolution of complex technical issues escalated by business users, prioritizing customer impact and meeting agreed SLAs
* Lead major/critical incident response, including triage, incident command, stakeholder communications, escalation, service restoration, and post-incident follow-up.
* Collaborate with vendors, application teams, infrastructure, data, security, and business partners to diagnose and resolve incidents while minimizing business impact.
* Facilitate technical troubleshooting and major incident calls, engaging the right teams at the right time and maintaining clear incident timelines, decisions, actions, and owners.
* Drive problem management and root cause analysis for recurring and major incidents; ensure corrective and preventive actions are prioritized, tracked, and completed to reduce recurrence.
* Ensure production releases, deployments, hotfixes, and change activities are operationally ready, appropriately tested, communicated, and validated after implementation.
* Partner with Loblaw technology and cross-functional teams on enterprise-level projects to define support readiness, monitoring, documentation, support processes, and transition-to-production requirements.
* Establish and monitor operational metrics such as SLA compliance, service availability, incident volume, backlog health, recurrence, and aging; use trends to drive service improvements.
* Develop a culture of continuous improvement through coaching, mentoring, runbooks, knowledge management, automation, and standardization of support practices.
* Act as a project lead on technology enhancement projects, driving scope, planning, execution, and cross-functional coordination to deliver improvements across Loblaw Brands technology systems.

* Minimum 5 years of experience in production support, application support, IT operations, or a similar role in a multi-system enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading production incidents, customer/business escalations, and issue resolution in a service-oriented environment.
* Experience with IT service management practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management.
* Solid knowledge of enterprise application platforms, including SAP; FileMaker Pro experience, SNOW ticket system remains an asset where relevant to the supported environment.
* Strong technical expertise in SQL, data analysis, database concepts, and Microsoft applications, particularly Excel; experience with service-management or collaboration tools is an asset.
* Understanding of application integrations, APIs, batch processing, networking, infrastructure dependencies, and cloud-based environments sufficient to troubleshoot production issues across systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills across all levels, including senior leadership, with the ability to communicate clearly during high-impact incidents.
* Strong problem-solving, prioritization, facilitation, and decision-making skills, with the ability to remain effective in high-pressure situations and coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors.
* Proficiency in process mapping and documentation using MS Visio or similar tools; ability to create and maintain runbooks, support procedures, and operational readiness documentation.

Title: Technical Operations Center Manager
Description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
As a Technical Operations Center (TOC) Manager, you will be one of three global managers operating in a "Follow the Sun" model, ensuring continuous 24/7 coverage and operational excellence across our technical infrastructure. This role is accountable for more than ticket throughput. It turns operational signals into measurable reliability outcomes by strengthening service ownership, leading disciplined incident response, reducing repeat failure and toil, and moving the organization toward proactive, increasingly automated operations. Your leadership will be crucial in facilitating seamless handoffs between shifts, maintaining high performance, and upholding and improving they systems and processes that create operational drag.
  
  
**Job Functions**
Service Reliability & Operational Leadership
  
  

* Lead day-to-day operations for the Technical Operations Center, ensuring critical infrastructure and services are operated safely, reliably and consistently.
* Establish and maintain a service-centric operating rhythm covering service ownership, criticality, dependencies, SLOs/SLIs, incident trends, capacity, risk and operational readiness.
* Partner with service owners, engineering, cybersecurity, business technology teams and vendors to identify reliability risks before they become business-impacting incidents.
* Use observability, telemetry and service health data to improve detection, prioritization and decision-making.
* Maintain a regular operating review and publish a concise scorecard focused on outcomes rather than activity.

Major Incident Management & Swarming
  
  

* Lead or sponsor response to major incidents, acting as Incident Commander or ensuring the appropriate command structure is in place.
* Establish clear incident roles, escalation triggers, communication standards and decision rights for high-severity events.
* Make swarming repeatable through shared queues, structured triage-ready information and timely engagement of the right technical and business partners.
* Coordinate internal teams and third-party providers through restoration, stakeholder communication and service validation.
* Ensure blameless postmortems convert incident learning into prioritized problem-management, reliability and prevention work.

Problem Management, Toil Reduction & Automation
  
  

* Maintain a ranked backlog of repeat incidents, operational toil, alert noise and manual work, with owners and measurable outcomes.
* Drive the conversion of repeatable procedures into versioned runbooks, scripts, workflows, automation and self-service capabilities.
* Apply AI-assisted triage and knowledge discovery where appropriate, with human oversight, security controls, auditability and clear escalation paths.
* Improve the quality, findability and lifecycle management of operational knowledge, including runbooks, known-error records, as-builts and shift documentation.
* Track automation adoption and toil hours avoided using the results to redirect capacity toward reliability engineering and service improvement.

Change, Release & Operational Readiness
  
  

* Strengthen risk-tiered change practices, including pre-checks, peer review, testing evidence, implementation plans, monitoring and rollback readiness.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to shift operational readiness earlier in the lifecycle, including supportability, observability, runbooks and ownership before release.
* Analyze change-related incidents and failure patterns leading corrective actions that improve change success and reduce recovery time.
* Support paved-road standards and a transparent exception process for common infrastructure, cloud, identity, network and systems patterns.

Global Coordination & Follow-the-Sun Operations
  
  

* Facilitate structured handoffs between global teams, ensuring the incoming shift receives current service health, active incidents, risks, decisions, next actions and escalation needs.
* Maintain consistent severity, response, handoff, change and review practices across regions while respecting local context and coverage requirements.
* Build strong working relationships across time zones, technical domains, business units and strategic vendors.
* Participate in a rotating global coverage and escalation model, including occasional out-of-hours or weekend coverage when required. The schedule should support sustainable coverage rather than routine weekend office attendance.

People Leadership & Capability Building
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop Technical Operations Center specialists, creating a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Set clear expectations for performance, incident leadership, documentation, operational discipline and customer experience.
* Hire, onboard and develop talent while building role-based learning paths and cross-training plans for critical domains.
* Establish resilient coverage with documented SME and backup relationships, reducing key-person dependency.

**Skills/Abilities**
Job Requirements:
  
  

* Deep technical knowledge in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations or related disciplines.
* Ability to assess impact, prioritize under pressure, communicate clearly and make sound decisions during high-severity events.
* Experience with service ownership, observability, SLOs/SLIs, operational readiness, runbooks and reliability metrics.
* Experience reducing operational toil through scripting, workflow automation, self-service or similar engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of cloud, identity, network, systems and/or enterprise infrastructure operations.
* Ability to build trust across engineering, security, business technology, vendors and geographically distributed teams.
* Commitment to blameless learning, continuous improvement and inclusive people leadership.

**Experience**

* Eight or more years of progressive experience in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations, IT service management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Three or more years leading technical teams, major incident response, operational programs or cross-functional reliability initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience operating mission-critical infrastructure or applications in a complex, globally distributed environment.
* Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service-level and knowledge-management practices.
* Experience leading a follow-the-sun operating model or global shift handoff process is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI-assisted operations, event correlation, anomaly detection or intelligent triage, with appropriate governance and human review.
* Experience implementing or improving a service catalog, SLO framework, error-budget practices or reliability scorecard.
* Experience with ITSM, observability, automation/orchestration and knowledge-management platforms.
* ITIL, SRE, cloud, automation or related certification.
* Experience leading a follow-the-sun operating model or global shift handoff process.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Industry-standard IT certifications are desirable; ITIL, SRE, cloud or automation certifications are a plus.

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

Title: Manager, Security and Compliance
Description:
Skillable is a 100% remote and virtual tech company that’s modernizing the world of training. Come share your professional magic with highly talented, driven and fun colleagues who believe in the power of “skilling.” Experience what a team focused on doing the right thing feels like!

Our talented people are what makes us friendly and have fun! We work together to create amazing solutions and experiences for our customers and their clients. Our remote-first work environment blends work and life without the added pressure of commuting or feeling guilty about leaving early to visit the dentist.

Come work with us and learn what teamwork and integrity blended with an emphasis on well-being and balance can do for your career and lifestyle!

The **Manager, Security and Compliance** leads the Cybersecurity and GRC teams that protect Skillable, its customers and its data. Own security operations, risk management and audit programs, using AI to scale the work while governing its safe use across the business. Translate security and compliance risk into clear business decisions for executives, customers and auditors and ensure teams have the strategy, priorities and direction needed to strengthen Skillable’s security posture.

**What You Will Do:**

* Own security operations, including identity, cloud security, vulnerability management and threat detection and response.
* Build a detection and response as code practice, using AI agents to triage alerts and automate response, with detections and playbooks managed in version control and tested.
* Own risk management, security policies and the SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 audit programs.
* Own the GRC platform and build a GRC engineering practice that uses code, integrations and AI agents to automate control monitoring and evidence collection.
* Run the AI governance program under ISO 42001, including the AI system inventory and AI risk and impact assessments.
* Manage third-party risk, using AI to speed vendor reviews while keeping a person accountable for every decision.
* Lead customer security reviews and questionnaires with Revenue, using AI to draft accurate answers from approved sources.
* Build a security-aware culture through practical training, including the safe use of AI tools.
* Set goals and KPIs, and report progress and top risks to leadership.
* Select and manage security and compliance tools and vendors.
* Partner with Engineering, Product Security and IT to secure AI agents, employee access and devices.
* Lead the team's shift to AI-assisted work, finding where agents can take on tasks while the team stays accountable for every outcome.
* Develop future leaders and succession plans for key roles through assigning regularly occurring responsibilities, mentoring and strategic delegation.
* Manage, coach and mentor direct reports to foster skill development, knowledge sharing, and technical growth.
* Develop, create and own the delivery of appropriate onboarding and training materials to ensure successful assimilation with the team and division.
* Contribute to interviewing and selecting new team members.
* Proactively integrate company-approved AI tools into day-to-day responsibilities, identifying opportunities to apply AI to role-specific tasks and workflows.
* Continuously evaluate opportunities to leverage AI to automate processes, solve problems, improve efficiency, and enhance the quality of individual and team outcomes.
* Use AI to enhance productivity, problem-solving, and decision-making where appropriate, while maintaining human judgment and accountability for the quality and accuracy of work.
* Support and promote the company values through positive interactions with both internal and external partners and customers on a regular basis.
* Other strategic business initiatives or cross-functional project involvement as required.

**What You Bring to the Role:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 8+ years of information security experience across security operations and compliance.
* 2+ years of professional work experience in a leadership position. Direct management oversight required.
* Action oriented in thoughtfully evaluating how and where AI can enhance work, while applying sound judgment, critical thinking, and appropriate human oversight.
* Natural curiosity and adaptability in learning, adopting and applying emerging AI capabilities to evolve ways of working across individual responsibilities and departments.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing people, as well as, promoting best practices and standards within department and industry.
* Experience running SOC 2, ISO 27001 or ISO 42001 audit programs.
* Hands-on experience administering a GRC platform and automating controls and evidence through GRC engineering and AI.
* Familiarity with detection and response as code, including version-controlled detections, automated response playbooks and AI-assisted triage.
* Working knowledge of GDPR, US state privacy laws and the EU AI Act.
* Hands-on experience using AI agents in security or compliance work, and understanding of the risks they introduce.
* Track record of running security as a business enabler and explaining risk clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA or ISO 42001 Lead Implementer are a plus.
* Confidence operating in an influential role, working collaboratively in cross-functional teams and contributing to company-wide initiatives.
* Proven ability to define short and long term strategy for scalability, operational efficiency and to ultimately drive execution.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively to various audiences/levels, both internal and external stakeholders, including leadership through various mediums.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize and manage workload and meet project deadlines.
* Proven organization skills with the ability to address short-term and long-term demands simultaneously.
* High-level of confidence, integrity and professional courtesy.
* Strong Microsoft suite experience, including teams or similar web conferencing and internal communication software experience preferred.

Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Further expanding our capabilities, in 2024, we introduced Cat5 Power Solutions, our Portable Power Sales and Rentals Division, delivering versatile power solutions to businesses and communities across the Southern US.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled service and repair commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs**

* Oversee preventive maintenance inspections and service of installed diesel and natural gas generators and ATS units.
* Review inspection findings, diagnose reported failures, and provide written repair recommendations and estimates for client approval.
* Schedule and oversee corrective repairs to controllers, alternators, starting systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, breakers, batteries, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Coordinate ATS inspections, testing, troubleshooting and repairs, including contactors, controls, relays and communication components.
* Enforce QA through service checklists, operational testing, inspection reports, photographs and complete asset-level work-order records.
* Manage repair warranties, repeat-failure investigations and complete service documentation.
* Ensure maintenance and repairs comply with applicable safety, environmental and waste-handling requirements, including oils, coolant, batteries and fuel.
* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

**Job Description**

As Head of Business Systems Product & Transformation for Fiix, Rockwell Automation's cloud-based maintenance management (CMMS) and asset management software business, you will own the systems and processes that run our software business from lead to cash to renewal.

  
  
  

Your first and most important priority is to perform: stabilize and run the business systems that support Fiix today. You will reduce a significant backlog, bring clear ownership and priorities, strengthen platform reliability and deliver at high velocity for Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success and Support.

  
  
  

Once the foundation is stable, you will lead the transformation: working with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation program to define the future-state operating model for the Fiix business (how our processes, systems and teams work across the Rockwell Automation organization) and to deliver coordinated outcomes across the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub.

  
  
  

You will lead a team of Lead Product Managers across three areas – Go-to-Market & Salesforce CRM, Product & Integration (including FactoryTalk Hub), and Revenue & Support Operations – and partner closely with a dedicated PMO and a business systems engineering team to turn strategy into delivered results.

  
  
  

**What Fiix Business Systems Does**

Our business systems connect how Fiix markets, sells, quotes, provisions, bills and supports its customers. The platform spans Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ), revenue and billing systems, middleware and integrations, product provisioning, and marketing and customer success tools. Today these systems are dedicated to Fiix. As Rockwell Automation's enterprise systems and software portfolio evolve, including FactoryTalk Hub, this role will help determine how Fiix systems and processes should work alongside them.

  
  
  

**Your Responsibilities**

Perform: Stabilize & Execute

* Stabilize the Fiix business systems in the first 6–12 months: triage and reduce the backlog, fix the highest-impact issues and restore confidence with business stakeholders.
* Establish clear ownership, service levels and measures of success for core systems and processes (e.g., backlog age, quote-to-cash cycle time, system reliability, data quality).
* Partner with the PMO on a single intake process, prioritization, capacity planning, budget and status reporting.
* Partner with the business systems engineering lead on release planning, platform stability and delivery quality.
* Run a regular operating rhythm: weekly prioritization, regular delivery cycles and monthly roadmap reviews with business stakeholders.
* Reduce backlog and operational friction through clear ownership, process simplification and automation.
* Keep near-term delivery aligned with the enterprise direction so today's work does not create rework later.
  

  
  

Strategy & Roadmap

* Own the end-to-end vision, multi-quarter roadmap and architecture principles across nine domains: go-to-market, Salesforce enterprise architecture, product provisioning, middleware and integration, case management and support, finance systems (FinTech), marketing technology, customer technology and data.
* Set priorities across the three product areas, balancing business value, risk, cost and engineering capacity.
* Translate company and business-unit goals into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes (e.g., quote-to-cash cycle time, forecast accuracy, data quality, backlog age, system adoption).
* Establish architectural standards and governance for changes that cross systems and teams.
  

  
  

Leadership & Team Development

* Lead, coach and develop Lead Product Managers; set clear decision rights, priorities and performance expectations.
* Build a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Recruit for open roles and strengthen capability through talent development and succession planning.
  

  
  

Cross-Functional Partnership

* Be a trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, Support, Product and IT leaders.
* Balance stakeholder priorities and facilitate cross-functional governance and communication.
* Coordinate with Product Engineering and IT on product provisioning, integrations, identity and access.
* Keep management, peers and team members informed on priorities, progress and risks. Transform: Future-State Operating Model
* As the business stabilizes, lead the shift to transformation in partnership with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team.
* Serve as the Fiix business systems lead with Rockwell Automation's enterprise commercial transformation team, representing Fiix requirements in future-state design, release planning and roadmap decisions.
* Develop a multi-year strategy that evaluates, process by process, the right future-state approach for Fiix (keeping Fiix-specific systems, connecting with Rockwell Automation enterprise systems, or adopting shared capabilities as they become ready), with clear decision points, sequencing and risks.
* Define the architecture and data model needed to give customers a seamless experience across Fiix, Rockwell Automation enterprise systems and the software portfolio, including FactoryTalk Hub, across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, renewal and support.
* Lead change management for the Fiix business as the operating model evolves, protecting business continuity and customer experience.

Description:

**The Role**

  

The **Senior Product Manager, Treasury Technology**, provides end-to-end functional leadership for the delivery and evolution of a complex Treasury technology platform. The role ensures business requirements, operating processes and downstream impacts are translated into a coherent solution, from requirements and design through implementation, transition and ongoing support.

  

Working across Front Office, Risk, Operations, Finance, Regulatory, Technology and vendor teams, the role maintains an end-to-end view of the product and its processes, challenges assumptions, identifies gaps and clarifies ownership. The successful candidate looks beyond documented requirements to understand how processes operate today, who performs them and how they should operate in the future state.

This hands-on, content-focused role requires deep functional knowledge and sound analytical judgement, working closely with project management, stakeholders, and technical teams to deliver the solution.

  

**Key Accountabilities**

**End-to-End Product and Process Oversight**

* Maintain a holistic view of the product across the full business and technology lifecycle, from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment and production support.
* Understand end-to-end business-process flows across Front Office, Risk, Operations, Finance, Regulatory and Technology functions.
* Identify dependencies and downstream impacts when business processes, data, products, controls or system capabilities change.
* Ensure individual workstreams and functional designs combine into a coherent overall solution and operating model rather than functioning as isolated components.
* Provide guidance on future-state product and process design while maintaining a strong understanding of current-state capabilities and operational practices.
* Support migration teams by offering end-to-end perspective and guidance on current-to-future-state process alignment, dependencies and downstream impacts, and by helping to validate that key processes and controls are considered.
  

**Requirements and Scope**

* Review existing scope, requirements, surveys and design documentation to develop a comprehensive understanding of agreed and proposed functionality.
* Challenge requirements to ensure they reflect actual business processes, control needs and intended outcomes rather than assumptions or system extracts alone.
* Facilitate discussions with business and technology stakeholders to validate requirements, ownership, dependencies and outcomes.
* Identify processes, controls and requirements that may be missing from documented scope, including infrequent, regional or specialised activities.
* Maintain traceability between business requirements, functional design decisions, implementation and testing.
  

**Functional Design and Solution Guidance**

* Participate actively in functional and product design sessions, providing an end-to-end perspective across workstreams.
* Evaluate design decisions against business processes, data, controls, operational needs and downstream impacts.
* Ensure the solution addresses the intent behind a requirement, not simply the documented data or existing technical implementation.
* Work closely with vendor product and solution specialists to assess platform capabilities and determine how they support the organisation’s operating requirements.
* Partner with technical architecture and engineering teams while maintaining clear distinction between functional and business-process design and infrastructure, integration and technical architecture responsibilities.
  

**Business Process, Ownership and Controls**

* Define and validate end-to-end business processes and establish clear roles and responsibilities across business, operations and technology teams.
* Identify gaps or ambiguity in process ownership and drive the appropriate stakeholders towards clear decisions.
* Ensure operational, regulatory, risk and control requirements are incorporated into functional designs.
* Consider infrequent but critical activities, including regulatory exercises, limit-management processes, product lifecycle events and regional requirements.
* Ensure future-state processes clearly establish accountability for execution, monitoring, escalation and evidence.
* Senior Product Manager - Treasury Technology
  

**Delivery and Testing Oversight**

* Maintain functional oversight as requirements move through design, build, configuration, integration and testing.

Title: Senior Manager, Specialty Operations (Remote)

This role will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy, and patient support operations for a rare disease product, with an initial focus on the successful commercialization of the new product launch. The role will also collaborate closely with Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure a seamless patient and provider experience.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Specialty Distribution Partner Management:**

* Support day-to-day operational execution across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services, ensuring coordination with internal teams and timely escalation of operational barriers.Partner with vendor program managers across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services to support operational activities, monitor open issues, and facilitate timely issue resolution and follow-up actions.

* Monitor and maintain operational performance standards with specialty distribution partners, ensuring alignment with agreed-upon service levels, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate resolution of operational barriers involving prescription processing, medical benefit reimbursement, buy-and-bill, institutional procurement, billing and claims, and alignment of product delivery with treatment scheduling, engaging appropriate functional experts as needed. Create and manage various channel/SD/SP communications and documents

* Work closely with the Channel Operations team to monitor/maintain optimal inventory levels.

* Support the maintenance, implementation, and periodic review of established business rules and operational procedures with specialty distribution partners.

* Contribute to development of product and channel specific contract strategies

  
  

**Collaboration with Internal Stakeholders:**

* Coordinate operational activities across the vendor program manager, Access Strategy, Patient Services, Trade & Distribution, Data & Analytics, and field leadership.

* Maintain documented responsibilities and handoffs, and route strategic, policy, and customer-facing decisions to the accountable function. Work cross-functionally with Market Access on product access issues and Medical team on resource development and pull-through.

* Develop relationships and work closely with the Patient Services team and/or Field Reimbursement Managers to help resolve patient/ provider access issues.

* Provide regular updates regarding partner performance, patient access issues, and any operational challenges, continuously evolving/challenging our support model with learnings related to medical/pharmacy benefit coverage learnings

* Collaborate with the team to continuously improve patient services and operational processes, including reviewing and optimizing workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

  
  

**Issue Investigation & Resolution:**

* Take ownership of investigating operational issues and work with internal and external teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

* Address challenges related to patient enrollment, medication distribution, insurance verification, or other issues impacting pharmacy operations.

* Escalate critical issues as needed and ensure effective communication with all relevant parties to resolve problems quickly and efficiently.

  
  

**Reporting & Data Analysis:**

* Identify appropriate metrics and tracking to ensure the right execution and success; analyze procedure volume, trends and growth for the specialty channel.

* Compile operational metrics, document performance trends, and provide reporting support for management reviews and business update meetings. Provide regular reports on operational performance, issue resolution, and process improvements to the Director of Specialty Operations.

* Analyze specialty reporting and work with data and analytics team to create patient, provider, physician, pharmacy and payer data dashboards in order to help improve processes

* Monitor specialty distributor/pharmacy data (ie; Time to First Fill, Conversion Rate, Gap days and Adherence)

  
  

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in regular process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing specialty distribution network operations and enhancing the patient experience.

* Provide input into the development and refinement of training materials, operational procedures, and best practices for working with specialty pharmacy partners.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, including hands-on management of specialty partner operations, patient services, and complex access workflows. Demonstrated experience coordinating hub, specialty pharmacy, and specialty distribution services and managing vendor performance is required.

* Experience with medical benefit therapies, institutional delivery, and launch implementation is preferred.

* Experience evaluating data sources for insights, specifically specialty distribution and patient services data.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* Pharmacy experience preferred

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.

Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:
***Get to know The Pokémon Company International***

The Pokémon Company International manages the Pokémon property outside of Asia and is responsible for brand management, licensing and marketing, the Pokémon Trading Card Game, the animated TV series, home entertainment, and the official Pokémon website. Pokémon was launched in Japan in 1996 and today is one of the most popular children's entertainment properties in the world.

Learn more online at corporate.pokemon.com and pokemon.com.

***Get to know the role***

* Job Title: Technical Program Manager
* Job Summary: The Technical Program Manager leads the program and project portfolio that advances IT Infrastructure & Services priorities, service maturity, and organizational capabilities. This role connects strategy to execution by turning business and technology priorities into an integrated roadmap, establishing the mechanisms needed to evaluate demand and sequence work, and providing leaders with clear information about business value, dependencies, risks, capacity, and decisions.This is an individual contributor role with accountability for portfolio governance, demand management, cross-functional alignment, and delivery of complex technology programs. The Technical Program Manager works through influence across technical teams and business stakeholders, partners with Operational Excellence to support broader Technology portfolio visibility, enables consistent execution across Project Managers and technical leaders, and directly leads selected high-priority or cross-departmental initiatives. Success will be measured by the clarity of portfolio decisions, alignment of stakeholders and resources, and business outcomes delivered through the program.
* FLSA Classification (US Only): Exempt
* People Manager: No

  

***What you'll do***

**Turn strategy into an executable program and portfolio**

* Own the integrated program and project portfolio for IT Infrastructure & Services, connecting related initiatives to service, capability, and business outcomes.
* Translate strategic priorities into roadmaps, sequenced initiatives, decision points, and clear ownership across delivery teams.
* Maintain a decision-ready view of portfolio health, business value, dependencies, risks, capacity constraints, resource needs, and expected outcomes.
* Provide practical recommendations and facilitate tradeoff decisions so leaders can prioritize investment and focus limited capacity on the highest-value work.

**Create disciplined demand, intake, and prioritization practices**

* Coordinate the intake and evaluation of proposed initiatives, ensuring requests have clear outcomes, sponsorship, scope, dependencies, risks, and resource implications.
* Facilitate prioritization and sequencing discussions that balance strategic importance, operational needs, capacity, risk, and business value.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to resolve ambiguity, clarify decisions, and communicate what will proceed, what will wait, and why.
* Continuously improve portfolio and demand-management processes while using the minimum governance necessary to create clarity, accountability, and effective decisions.

**Lead complex, high-value initiatives**

* Directly lead selected strategic, high-priority, or cross-departmental technology programs from definition through delivery and adoption.
* Establish program structures, integrated plans, governance, communications, and escalation paths appropriate to the complexity and business impact of the work.
* Anticipate and manage cross-project dependencies, resource conflicts, risks, and decisions that could affect outcomes or timelines.
* Keep stakeholders aligned on commitments, tradeoffs, progress, and expected business outcomes while adapting plans as priorities and conditions change.

**Build alignment across technology and business stakeholders**

* Coordinate work across Information Security, Online Services, Game Studio, Media Production, Automated Retail, Localization, and other partners whose priorities and decisions affect the portfolio.
* Build trusted relationships with technical leaders, service owners, Project Managers, and business stakeholders, creating shared understanding of priorities and accountability.
* Partner closely with Operational Excellence to provide accurate and consistent portfolio information for broader Technology planning and leadership decisions.
* Translate complex technical, delivery, and capacity information into concise recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

**Enable consistent portfolio execution**

* Establish common expectations for project governance, status reporting, risk and dependency management, decision tracking, and outcome measurement.
* Enable delivery across multiple Project Managers, technical leaders, and service owners by improving visibility, coordination, and escalation across initiatives.
* Use portfolio data and delivery insights to identify recurring issues, improve planning quality, and strengthen execution over time.
* Promote practical use of tools, automation, and standardized practices that reduce administrative effort and improve portfolio transparency.

  

***What you'll bring***

**Program and portfolio leadership**

* 8+ years of experience in technical program management, portfolio management, project management, or a related technology delivery role, including leadership of complex cross-functional programs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio or broad program domain involving multiple projects, technical teams, stakeholders, dependencies, and competing priorities.

Title: IT Operations Manager
Description:
**Job Description**

The Texas General Land Office is seeking a Manager VII (IT Operations Manager) within the Information Technology Services Department of the agency.

Performs highly advanced managerial work administering the daily operations and activities of the Information Technology Services (ITS) Cloud Operations function. The Cloud Operations Manager leads staff responsible for the agency's cloud, infrastructure, and technology operations and ensures services support GLO programs reliably, securely, and efficiently.

Work involves establishing goals, priorities, guidelines, procedures, and service standards; directing staff performance and development; coordinating daily operations and modernization initiatives; evaluating service performance and operational risk; developing and monitoring budget requests and expenditures; and recommending improvements. The position coordinates with ITS teams, security and governance partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to align services and resources with agency needs.

**Our Mission:**

The Texas General Land Office primarily serves the schoolchildren, veterans, and the environment of Texas. The agency does so by preserving our history, maximizing state revenue through innovative administration, and through the prudent stewardship of state lands and natural resources.

**What Your Contributions to the GLO Will be:**

* People Leadership & Team Management: Directly supervises and supports individual contributors by setting expectations, assigning and prioritizing work, monitoring performance, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional development. Builds a cohesive, accountable team environment; addresses performance issues; and ensures staff have the skills, tools, and resources needed to meet operational objectives.
* Operational Execution & Team Delivery: Executes established strategies and plans by coordinating day-to-day team activities, managing priorities and schedules, tracking progress against goals, and resolving operational issues. Ensures work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with agency policies, standards, and service expectations.
* Cloud Strategy & Infrastructure Modernization: Leads planning and modernization of the agency's cloud and infrastructure environments. Sets priorities for cloud readiness, migration, platform lifecycle, capacity, and technical debt reduction. Coordinates with technology teams and business stakeholders to align work with agency needs.
* Infrastructure Reliability, Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Oversees the reliability and availability of infrastructure services, including continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. Directs work to improve backup, recovery, monitoring, capacity, and service resilience, and tracks recovery objectives for critical systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance: Coordinates with security and governance partners to reduce operational risk and support compliance. Oversees implementation of approved controls for access management, secure configuration, network protection, logging, vulnerability remediation, and audit response across infrastructure services.
* Budget, Procurement & Vendor Oversight: Monitors budgets, procurement, contracts, and vendor performance for CloudOps services. Evaluates resource needs and technology options, monitors expenditures, and recommends investments that support agency priorities and operational efficiency.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, business administration, or a related field; relevant education and experience may be considered in combination.
* At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology operations, infrastructure, cloud services, systems administration, or a closely related field.
* At least three (3) years of experience supervising or leading technical staff, including assigning work, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and supporting staff development.
* Experience coordinating technology operations or modernization work across teams, assessing service risks, and communicating status and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting infrastructure reliability, security controls, service continuity, or disaster recovery in an enterprise environment.

**Location Requirement:**
This position is based in Austin, TX. Candidates must be currently located in the Austin area or willing to relocate at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not provided.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, cloud or infrastructure services, or technology service delivery, including several years in a management role.
* Experience in a state agency, public-sector, or similarly regulated environment, including familiarity with security, audit, procurement, and records requirements.
* Experience with cloud adoption and migration, hybrid infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise networking, backup and recovery, and monitoring or observability.
* Experience managing operating budgets, service contracts, vendors, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident response, and service performance measures.

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires the employee to primarily perform sedentary office work; however, mobility (moving around the worksite) is routinely required to carry out some duties. This position requires extensive computer, telephone and client/ customer contact and communication. It requires the ability to move and position oneself as needed for filing and similar routine office duties. The job also requires normal cognitive abilities requiring the ability to learn, recall, and apply certain practices and policies. It requires the stamina to maintain attention to detail despite interruptions. Ability to read printed materials and computer screens. The individual must be able to move and transport records, documents, boxes, and all related information and materials, weighing up to 20 pounds when required.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Free Parking
* Defined Retirement Benefit Plan Optional 401(k) and 457 accounts
* Medical Insurance - State pays 100% of the health plan premium for eligible full-time employees and 50% of the premium for their eligible dependents. The State pays 50% of the eligible part-time employees' premium and 25% for eligible dependents.
* Optional Benefits such as dental, vision, and life insurance.
* Minimum of 96+ Hours of Annual Leave a year \*\*Annual leave increases with length of service.
* Professional Development Opportunities: The GLO offers numerous courses to help our employees grow using resources through LinkedIn Learning and our EAP provider.

**Veterans:**

Use your military skills to qualify for this position or other jobs! Go to www.texasskillstowork.com to translate your military work experience and training courses into civilian job terms, qualifications, and skill sets. Also, you can compare this position to military occupations (MOS) at the Texas State Auditor's Office by pasting this link into your browser:

Military Crosswalk for Occupational Category - Information Technology

**How to Apply:**

* To be considered for this position, please submit your application online through the CAPPS Career Site (preferred method) or complete a State of Texas Application in WorkInTexas at www.workintexas.com. It is not necessary to apply through both WorkInTexas and the CAPPS Career Site.
* Applications must be fully completed and include a comprehensive employment history, detailing job titles, dates of employment, employer names, supervisors' names and phone numbers, and a summary of responsibilities. Submission of a résumé is also required.
* In accordance with federal law, all individuals selected for hire will be required to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the appropriate employment eligibility verification documentation upon hire.
* Positions assigned to this classification are designated as security-sensitive pursuant to Texas Labor Code, Section 301.042.
* Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. The agency is unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa.

Title: Enterprise Program Manager (ELM)

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Title: Director - Worker Welfare (RD 4)
Description:
Job Summary

Lead the Worker Welfare function for City Operations, with a practical focus on occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics and the quality of the working environment. Establish the governance, assurance and monitoring arrangements needed to protect worker wellbeing, identify workplace risks and support fair, safe and healthy working conditions across City Operations and its service-provider activities.

Core Responsibilities  

* Lead the City Operations Worker Welfare function and translate corporate requirements into practical standards, plans and controls.
* Establish a worker welfare governance, assurance and monitoring framework covering occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics, welfare facilities and working-environment conditions.
* Develop risk-based inspection and review programs for City Operations workplaces and service-provider operations.
* Monitor worker welfare performance, trends, concerns and corrective actions, escalating material issues to leadership.
* Coordinate with Health & Safety, FLS, Human Capital, Procurement, Operations, Asset Management and service providers to embed worker welfare requirements into operational delivery.
* Support the assessment and improvement of workplace ergonomics, job design, welfare facilities and environmental conditions affecting worker health and wellbeing.
* Oversee investigation and follow-up of worker welfare concerns, non-compliances and recurring workplace issues.
* Ensure worker welfare requirements are incorporated into contractor scopes, mobilization, performance monitoring and service reviews.
* Build awareness and capability through guidance, training and engagement with employees and service providers.

  
Specific Responsibilities  

* Develop and maintain the City Operations Worker Welfare Plan, procedures, checklists and reporting arrangements.
* Maintain a worker welfare risk and action register with accountable owners and closure evidence.
* Coordinate occupational health and ergonomic assessments where required and track recommended improvements.
* Conduct or coordinate worker interviews, workplace observations and welfare-facility reviews as part of assurance activities.
* Produce periodic dashboards and management reports covering leading indicators, findings, trends and overdue actions.
* Support continual improvement of working conditions across City Operations.

Generic Responsibilities

* Contribute to annual business planning, workforce planning and budget management for the function.
* Lead, coach and develop assigned teams and specialist service providers.
* Promote a culture of accountability, prevention, continual improvement and evidence-based decision-making.
* Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports, presentations and recommendations to City Operations leadership.
* Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements

Key Internal Interactions

* City Operations leadership and functional directors
* Health & Safety, FLS and Environmental teams
* Human Capital and Employee Relations
* Contracts & Procurement
* Operations, Asset Management and Community Management
* Governance, Risk & Controls
* Communications and relevant project/handover teams

Key External Interactions

* Relevant government and regulatory authorities
* Occupational health and ergonomics specialists
* Operations, maintenance and service-provider contractors
* Worker welfare auditors and consultants
* Healthcare and employee-assistance providers, as applicable
* Developers and delivery partners

 **Requirements**

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in occupational health, Health & Safety, Human Factors, Ergonomics, Public Health, Human Resources or a closely related discipline.
* Master’s degree in a relevant field is desirable.

Professional certifications

* Relevant professional certification in occupational health and safety, ergonomics, worker welfare or auditing is desirable.
* Professional membership with a recognized health, safety, ergonomics or human-resources body is desirable.

Skills

* Strong knowledge of worker welfare, occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics and working-environment controls.
* Strong inspection, investigation, assurance and corrective-action management skills.
* Ability to engage constructively with workers, managers, contractors and senior leadership.
* Strong analytical, reporting, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive welfare matters professionally and consistently

Title: Senior Manager - Landscaping Ops - City 205- AA7
Description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a **Senior Manager – Landscape Operations** to lead the operation and maintenance of assigned landscapes, green spaces and parks across Qiddiya City. This is an opportunity to combine horticultural expertise with operational leadership, creating healthy, well-presented outdoor environments that are safe and ready for public use.

### **What you’ll do**

* **Lead landscape maintenance:** Develop annual, seasonal and weekly programmes covering trees, palms, shrubs, groundcover, turf and seasonal planting, including pruning, nutrition, soil improvement, integrated pest management and replacement.
* **Optimise irrigation and water use:** Oversee irrigation systems within the assigned asset boundary, adapting schedules to plant demand, seasonal conditions and soil moisture. Investigate leaks and abnormal consumption, and implement approved water-efficiency measures.
* **Manage contractor performance:** Hold service providers accountable against contractual scopes, service-level agreements and KPIs, validating completed work, addressing non-conformance and recommending payment certification through approved processes.
* **Maintain landscape quality and park readiness:** Inspect planting health, asset condition and presentation, coordinate specialist tree-risk assessments, and work with cleaning, waste, security, maintenance and event teams to resolve issues affecting public use.
* **Support mobilisation and handover:** Contribute to design and maintainability reviews, verify asset information, irrigation drawings, maintenance manuals, training and spares, and track snags and defects before recommending operational acceptance.
* **Control budgets and resources:** Prepare operating budgets, resource plans and forecasts, monitor expenditure and unit costs, and coordinate teams, equipment and specialist support without compromising safety, plant health or service quality.
* **Strengthen resilience and performance:** Maintain contingency arrangements for irrigation failures, extreme weather, plant-health incidents and event damage. Use CAFM or approved maintenance systems to track work, report performance and inform renewal priorities.
* **Develop a safe, capable team:** Coach operational teams, build accountability and embed health, safety and environmental controls for activities involving the public, heat exposure, machinery, chemicals and work at height.

 **Requirements**  

### **What you’ll bring**

* A **bachelor’s degree in Horticulture, Landscape Management, Agriculture, Landscape Architecture or a related discipline**
* **At least 10 years of relevant landscape, horticulture or parks operations and maintenance experience**, including **5 years managing operational teams and service contracts**.
* Demonstrated delivery of large-scale landscape and irrigation maintenance across parks, urban public realm, mixed-use developments or destination environments. **Experience in hot, arid climates is essential.**
* Experience managing outsourced services, operational budgets, plant establishment, mobilisation and asset handover.
* Strong technical knowledge of arid-climate horticulture, plant health, soils, turf, tree care, irrigation and water efficiency.
* Capabilities in maintenance planning, asset-condition assessment, contractor performance management, commercial controls and environmental risk management, supported by CAFM and reporting skills.
* Clear communication, stakeholder coordination and team leadership skills, with the ability to turn operational priorities into consistent service delivery.

Skills

* Expert knowledge of operational fire safety compliance, fire-protection system maintenance, emergency-response readiness and assurance.
* Strong knowledge of Fire and Rescue Service governance and Facilities Management interfaces.

Title: Director IT Governance , Risk and Compliance

CIBC Mellon is a leading provider of asset servicing solutions to institutional investors in Canada, including multi-currency accounting, fund valuation, and investment information reporting. We are passionate about providing exceptional client service backed by our culture of innovation and success. Our outstanding employee experience will provide you with opportunities to learn and grow professionally while supporting the communities in which you live and work.
  
  
We are a diverse and dynamic workplace where employees take an active role in delivering on strategic objectives while advancing their individual career goals. We encourage innovative thinking and give our employees the support and resources they need to turn great ideas into actions.
  
  
We’re always looking for talented people who can make a meaningful difference for our clients, our company and our communities. To learn more about why our employees love coming to work each day, visit www.cibcmellon.com/experience.

Reporting into the Assistant Vice President, Enterprise Security, the Director, IT Governance, Risk and Compliance is responsible for directing the development, implementation, and maintenance of the Technology risk, controls and standards framework, and provides assurance to the Executive team, Directors, Shareholders and Regulators that technology and security risks are being measured and managed appropriately across the organization.

**Responsibilities:**

* Drives the execution of technology and security risk, controls and standards practices across the Information Technology organization, ensuring risks are identified, assessed, mitigated and reported consistently.
* Develops technology and security risk management strategies for CIBC Mellon by establishing enterprise frameworks, standards and methods to validate adherence.

- The salary band for this position ranges between $126,000 - $176,000.
