Title: Senior Manager, Fulfillment
Description:
**Who We Are**

Chomps is America's fastest-growing meat snack brand, redefining convenient snacking with a commitment to real ingredients and bold, satisfying flavors. Crafted from 100% grass-fed, grass-finished beef and venison, along with antibiotic-free turkey and chicken, each Chomps meat stick delivers 10+ grams of high-quality protein without sugar, hormones, soy, dairy, artificial preservatives, artificial nitrates, or MSG. Seasoned with a blend of flavorful herbs and spices, Chomps provides a nutritious protein snack for the whole family. As a minority-owned, family-operated, and B Corporation-certified business, Chomps prioritizes thoughtful sourcing and recently earned the non–ultra-processed food certification through the non-GMO project. Discover a new standard in snacking at www.chomps.com.

**Traits of a Chompian**

If you've been called nimble, resourceful, and persistent, then you might just be a Chompian. You're a team player who's self-motivated and action-oriented. You're committed to delivering efficiency and accuracy, and you happen to be great at proactive cross-functional communication. You're a critical thinker and a natural problem solver who enjoys details, research, and data. You take initiative and complete ownership of everything you do, and you'll go the extra mile for your team, consumers, and audience. You're hungry to learn with a passion to grow and improve every day. You also take a keen interest in health, fitness, and nutrition. Sound like you? Then we want to meat you.

**What You Will Do**

The Senior Manager, Fulfillment is responsible for managing day-to-day fulfillment execution and the customer service function to ensure Chomps' fulfillment network operates with accuracy, accountability, cost discipline, and scalability. This role translates established fulfillment priorities into clear operating routines and partner expectations across multiple distribution locations and 3PL partners. The ideal candidate brings strong fulfillment and 3PL management experience, understands order execution and customer service operations, and can turn complex operational priorities into practical processes, measurable results, and clear cross-functional communication.

**Role Expectations:** This role is expected to independently manage recurring fulfillment and customer service cadences, 3PL partner follow-up, KPI reporting, process controls, order exception management, and customer escalations. This role will also provide operational inputs, data analysis, customer and service insights, risk visibility, and execution support to leadership for network planning, budget development, partner governance, and material service, cost, compliance, or performance escalations.

**Responsibilities**

* **Fulfillment Network Operations & 3PL Management**
  + Support daily fulfillment operations across a growing multi-node distribution network, ensuring accurate order execution, capacity readiness, inventory flow, cost discipline, and consistent partner follow-through.
  + Manage weekly and monthly 3PL operating cadences, including partner meetings, KPI reviews, action-item tracking, QBR content preparation, performance follow-up, corrective action tracking, SLA monitoring, root-cause analysis, and readiness checkpoints.
  + Create, maintain, and continuously improve scalable SOPs, process controls, compliance requirements, and partner playbooks covering receiving, inventory control, order release, allocation, pick/pack/ship execution, exception management, and partner escalation paths, ensuring consistent execution across distribution nodes and customer channels.
  + Support fulfillment budget management by preparing invoice audits, spend analysis, productivity tracking, cost-per-order or cost-per-case reporting, and cost-reduction recommendations across the partner network.
* **Order Management & Allocation**
  + Manage order allocation across wholesale, retail, eCommerce, and other channels, balancing customer requirements, inventory availability, freight efficiency, production constraints, and service commitments.
  + Partner with Sales, Planning, Transportation, Finance, Customer Supply Chain, and Operations to execute customer requirements, manage order flow constraints, support inventory positioning decisions, and provide cost-to-serve inputs.
  + Drive proactive exception management for constrained inventory, customer allocation decisions, backorder risk, order holds, shipment readiness, and cross-functional communication.
* **Customer Service**
  + Lead day-to-day customer service for wholesale, retail, distributor, and eCommerce accounts, serving as the operational link between Chomps' fulfillment network and its customers. Oversee order status and shipment inquiries, the shared Customer Service inbox, and open-order review, catching PO issues (pricing errors, MOQ shortfalls, unapproved NetSuite POs, missed ship-by dates) before shipment.
  + Set the team's structure and standards, including priorities, ownership boundaries, escalation paths, channel coverage, backup plans, a shared tracker, and an SOP library. Define and monitor KPIs such as inbox response time, on-time weekly PO updates, PO issue resolution time, OTIF, and fill rate.
  + Serve as the primary supply chain point of contact for key customers, supporting business reviews and new-customer onboarding. Partner with Sales, Account Management, Planning, and Quality to resolve customer issues and deliver weekly PO status updates, cut and delay notices, post-allocation ETAs, key-account update files, and customer portal PO approvals.
  + Own processes for PO revisions, cancellations, and expedites; UDRs, shortages, damages, and returns; and chargebacks, deductions, and disputes, with clear ownership from intake through resolution. Manage retailer compliance (routing guides, vendor manuals, labeling mandates, ASN accuracy, EDI readiness, and appointment scheduling) to protect OTIF and minimize penalties.
  + Turn customer feedback and performance trends into process improvements, driving root-cause analysis and corrective action with 3PLs, carriers, and internal teams to reduce chargebacks, shorten PO-to-delivery cycle time, and manage cost-to-serve. Partner with Planning on retailer demand signals, In-Stock %, Weeks of Supply, and CPFR with key accounts.
* **Technology, Reporting & KPIs**
  + Support business-side execution of order management and fulfillment automation improvements, including reducing manual touches, improving order accuracy, strengthening exception workflows, supporting UAT, driving adoption, and increasing visibility across systems and 3PL partners.
  + Partner with Digital Transformation, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, and 3PL technology teams on NetSuite and partner-system improvements, including requirements, EDI/API integrations, order routing logic, reporting, issue tracking, and operational controls.
  + Own fulfillment scorecards and KPI reporting across service, cost, compliance, productivity, inventory flow, automation adoption, customer requirements, and partner performance, converting recurring issues into corrective action plans, partner follow-up, leadership-ready updates, and prioritized improvement recommendations.
  + Build ad hoc analyses that identify service risks, cost drivers, recurring partner issues, customer compliance exposure, inventory constraints, and opportunities for process improvement.
* **Launch Readiness**
  + Manage operational readiness for fulfillment, ensuring 3PL processes, documentation flows, lot traceability, shipment readiness, customer requirements, and exception management are defined and consistently executed.
  + Coordinate operational launch readiness for new customers, channels, facilities, lanes, and market launches by confirming people, processes, systems, inventory, documentation, partner capabilities, and escalation paths are aligned before go-live.
* **People & Cross-Functional Leadership**
  + Guide, coach, and develop customer service and fulfillment team members as applicable, and influence cross-functional stakeholders, by reinforcing clear ownership, operating rhythms, priorities, and expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and disciplined follow-through.
  + Partner with cross-functional teams and external partners to align on execution priorities, resolve constraints, and support fulfillment growth.
  + Translate business growth priorities into practical execution plans, partner requirements, system needs, process controls, and team readiness actions.
  + Provide operational insights, data-backed recommendations, implementation support, and disciplined follow-through to support leadership decisions related to network planning, transportation, contracts, budgets, partner performance, and risk response.

**Who You Are**

* 7+ years of progressive experience in fulfillment, distribution planning, customer supply chain, logistics, or 3PL operations, including experience managing complex multi-node distribution networks and customer-facing operational process.
* Demonstrated ability to manage 3PL partners, operational KPIs, QBRs, corrective actions, SLA follow-up, and fulfillment performance across multiple facilities or business channels.
* Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, EDI, API, and order management systems; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.
* Proven ability to identify, design, and implement automation or process improvement opportunities that improve order accuracy, reduce manual work, accelerate cycle times, and strengthen operational visibility.
* Highly analytical and comfortable using data to make recommendations on allocation, cost-to-serve, service risk, inventory positioning, readiness gaps, and partner performance.
* Strong understanding of fulfillment and supply chain metrics, including OTIF, fill rate, order cycle time, inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, cost-per-order or cost-per-case, 3PL SLA performance, chargeback exposure, and capacity utilization.
* Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence Sales, Planning, Finance, Operations, Quality, Digital Transformation, and external partners without always having direct authority.
* Comfortable operating at both planning and execution levels, moving from operational readiness and issue resolution to SOP development, partner follow-up, and process improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communicator with the ability to translate operational complexity into clear recommendations, leadership-ready updates, and partner-facing expectations.
* Entrepreneurial, proactive, and process-oriented; energized by building scalable systems, improving ways of working, and creating structure in a high-growth environment.
* Demonstrated p[eople leadership experience, including coaching, prioritization, ownership setting, and development of team members.
* Willingness to travel up to 30% to distribution centers, partner sites, customer meetings, and cross-functional business reviews.

Raise the team's technical depth, set clear expectations for investigation quality and operational ownership, and manage span of control, shift staffing and succession so that no service line depends on a single person.
* Partner with Cyber Strategy, Risk and GRC, Offensive Security, Identity and Access Management, Enterprise Fraud, Enterprise Architecture, Cloud and Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal, Internal Audit and entity compliance officers. Provide evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF and regulator reviews covering detection and response controls.

Title: Senior Manager, Joy & Listening Strategy
Description:
Requisition ID # 175774
  
  
**Job Category:** Customer Support / Operations
  
**Job Level:** Senior Manager
  
**Business Unit:** People
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Oakland
  
  
Department Summary
  
  
The Enterprise Engagement team helps create the conditions for coworkers to thrive and for teams to perform at their best. We connect coworker insights, culture, inclusion and belonging, and performance practices to strengthen the everyday coworker experience and help the organization deliver on its Purpose, Virtues, and Stands.
  
  
The team leads enterprise strategies and programs that shape and strengthen culture, including Joy at Work, Breakthrough, and Inclusion & Belonging. We use coworker listening, data, and insights to understand the experiences and mindsets influencing culture, identify opportunities for improvement, and help translate those insights into focused action.
  
  
Through enterprise programs, tools, and partnerships, the team helps leaders and teams strengthen connection, belonging, ownership, and performance; embed desired ways of working into the everyday coworker experience, and build the capabilities needed to turn culture into a driver of business outcomes.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Manager, Joy & Listening Strategy is responsible for leading PG&E’s enterprise Joy at Work listening, measurement, and improvement strategy to advance the coworker experience and drive achievement of the enterprise Joy at Work L1 metric. This role oversees the collection, analysis, and translation of coworker feedback into actionable insights, strategic priorities, and measurable improvements, with a particular focus on frontline coworkers and organizations with the greatest opportunity for improvement.
  
  
The Senior Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight of enterprise listening programs, including but not limited to Joy at Work surveys, Joy Pulse and Joy Daily, ensuring a coordinated approach to measuring coworker sentiment, identifying key performance drivers, and evaluating the effectiveness of improvement actions. This role leads a team of analysts and program professionals and partners with functional area leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen accountability, accelerate improvement and embed data-informed decision-making into enterprise operating rhythms.
  
  
The role is hybrid working from your remote office and in-person at Oakland General Office, 1-2x weekly based on business needs.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
Lead the development and execution of PG&E’s enterprise Joy at Work listening and measurement strategy, establishing priorities, performance expectations and improvement opportunities that drive achievement of the enterprise L1 Joy at Work metric. Partner with functional areas to identify performance gaps, evaluate improvement plans, and accelerate progress toward enterprise targets. Oversee the enterprise listening ecosystem, including Joy at Work surveys, Joy Pulse, Joy Daily and other feedback mechanisms. Establish consistent approaches to collecting, analyzing, and interpreting coworker sentiment, ensuring insights are timely, actionable, and connected to enterprise priorities. Develop targeted listening and measurement strategies that elevate frontline coworker perspectives, address participation and accessibility barriers, and identify opportunities to improve the frontline experience. Partner with operational leaders to translate frontline insights into prioritized improvement actions and measurable outcomes. Direct the analysis of Joy performance drivers, sentiment trends, and coworker feedback to inform enterprise priorities and leadership decisions. Establish consistent methods to evaluate the effectiveness of functional area Joy improvement plans, recommend adjustments, and strengthen the connection between listening, action, and results. Lead the integration of Joy insights and performance measures into enterprise operating rhythms, including Joy Councils, monthly operating reviews, leadership forums, and structured problem-solving. Establish clear performance expectations, escalation processes, and follow-up mechanisms to drive accountability and continuous improvement. Lead, coach, and develop a team of analysts and program professionals responsible for survey execution, data analytics, strategic insights, and program delivery. Partner with enterprise leaders, functional areas, and cross-functional teams to align priorities, strengthen execution and deliver measurable improvements in the coworker experience. Oversee complex and unique strategic planning projects and initiatives that are of highest visibility and impact. Create and implement long-term research and analytical strategies, ensuring effective execution to apply insights across product, marketing, customer, and integration strategies on a daily basis. Act as an advocate for coworkers to all areas of the Company. Lead identification of new and existing technologies and processes. Develop and manage budgets, across multiple funding sources and identify innovations and cost-reduction potential of new and existing technologies and processes and implement contract management process improvement.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, Statistics, or equivalent experience. 6 years of experience in utilities, retail, financial services, consumer products, or telecommunications including supervisory/managerial experience. 4 years’ experience in customer strategy work in the utility, financial services, telecommunications, or consumer products sectors.
  
  
**Desired Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  
Strong experience in implementing and using customer qualitative/quantitative research methods, tools, and applications of statistical analysis. Proven track record in defining strategic objectives and setting metrics and performance measures. Experience in successfully managing vendor relationships. Experience developing and implementing customer experience tools, i.e., journey maps, service blueprints, etc. Experience applying Lean methodology. Knowledge of concepts, best practices, tools, techniques, and strategies related to conducting behavioral analysis as needed to perform at the job level. Ability to read and understand information and ideas presented through written words and sentences as need to perform at the job level. Competency in developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences. Ability to create graphics, maps, schematics, or diagrams to present information as needed to perform at the job level. Competency in making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems. Competency in adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations. Competency in building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. Knowledge of concepts, best practices, tools, techniques, and strategies related to intelligence data gathering, analysis, and decision-making as needed to perform at the job level.
  
  
Compensation
  
  
PG&E is providing the full salary/pay range for this position. The actual amount paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, and geographic location. The range to reasonably expect will be around the minimum and the midpoint of the range. The final decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to the factors above. This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.

Title: Bilingual Director of Aging and Disability Programs
Description:
The Director of Aging and Disability Programs is responsible for the leadership, operations, financial performance, staff supervision, and quality of UCC’s Aging and Disability programs. These include the Senior Center, Housing Programs, Adult Day Center, Family Care, Memory Clinic, and Transportation.

The Director directly manages Senior Center operations and supervises the Housing Coordinator. The Director oversees Family Care and the Adult Day Center through their program managers and supervisors and provides leadership to Memory Clinic and Transportation staff.

This position ensures that programs provide safe, respectful, culturally responsive services to older adults and adults with disabilities. The Director works closely with the Chief Operating Officer, Finance, Human Resources, program staff, funders, and community partners to address program needs, meet requirements, and maintain effective operations.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Program Leadership and Operations**
-------------------------------------

* Direct and evaluate Aging and Disability programs to ensure services meet participant needs and support UCC’s mission.
* Establish program priorities, annual goals, work plans, and clear expectations for staff.
* Review enrollment, attendance, referrals, service delivery, staffing, and program outcomes to identify concerns and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and maintain procedures that support consistent operations and clear responsibilities.
* Address operational concerns promptly and communicate significant issues, recommendations, and pending decisions to the Chief Operating Officer.
* Coordinate services and referrals across programs to improve access and continuity of support.

**Financial Management and Accountability**

* Work with Finance and the Chief Operating Officer to develop and monitor program budgets.
* Review financial reports regularly, investigate differences between budgeted and actual results, and follow through on corrective actions.
* Monitor enrollment, attendance, staffing costs, billing, revenue, expenses, and other factors affecting financial performance.
* Ensure accurate and timely submission of information needed for billing, reimbursement, financial reporting, and grant reporting.
* Review purchasing requests, invoices, expense vouchers, and other financial documents within assigned authority and follow UCC approval procedures.
* Identify financial concerns early and develop practical plans to address them.

**Staff Supervision and Development**
-------------------------------------

* Supervise assigned managers, supervisors, coordinators, and staff; establish clear responsibilities and reporting relationships.
* Hold regular meetings to review priorities, staffing concerns, participant needs, financial performance, and outstanding action items.
* Work with Human Resources on recruitment, hiring, onboarding, training, performance evaluations, and employee relations.
* Provide coaching and timely feedback and ensure supervisors address performance and conduct concerns.
* Ensure required training, credentials, personnel documentation, and performance records are completed and maintained.
* Delegate appropriately and hold staff accountable for completing work accurately and on time.
* Promote respectful communication, teamwork, and consistent follow-through.

**Senior Center**
-----------------

* Directly manage daily Senior Center operations, staff, volunteers, and program activities.
* Plan and coordinate educational, recreational, social, and wellness activities that support independence and participant engagement.
* Oversee nutrition services and coordinate with staff and partners to address service, safety, and participant needs.
* Ensure accurate attendance and activity participation records and timely reports to funding sources and other partners.
* Maintain regular contact with participants and respond to concerns and suggestions.
* Coordinate speakers, classes, community resources, and outreach activities.

**Elderly Housing**
-------------------

* Supervise the Housing Coordinator and oversee UCC’s responsibilities for Davila, UCC Village, and Olga Village.
* Monitor occupancy, vacancies, resident concerns, rent collection, outstanding balances, and property needs, as applicable to each property.
* Coordinate with Finance, Facilities, property partners, and other staff to address maintenance, financial, and operational matters.
* Ensure resident concerns and unresolved issues receive timely attention and follow-up.
* Review required housing records, reports, and partner commitments.

**Adult Day Center**
--------------------

* Supervise and support the ADC Supervisor in managing daily operations, staffing, participant services, and programming.
* Ensure services reflect participant needs, abilities, preferences, and care plans.
* Review staffing coverage, participant attendance, referrals, admissions, discharges, and caregiver concerns.
* Ensure supervisors and qualified clinical staff address participant care, documentation, incidents, and changes in condition.
* Coordinate with nursing staff and Transportation to support safe and consistent services.
* Monitor program quality, safety, and completion of corrective actions.

**Family Care**
---------------

* Oversee Family Care program leadership and monitor staffing, caseloads, service delivery, documentation, and program performance.
* Ensure program leaders maintain processes for timely assessments, care planning, service coordination, and participant follow-up.
* Monitor performance against contractual expectations and address outstanding concerns with program leadership.
* Maintain communication with the contracted managed care organization and other relevant partners.
* Ensure clinical and professional decisions are handled by appropriately qualified staff.

**Memory Clinic**
-----------------

* Oversee Memory Clinic operations, staff coordination, outreach, and grant-supported activities.
* Work with staff and clinical partners to support screenings, referrals, appointments, and participant and caregiver follow-up.
* Monitor grant goals, spending, deliverables, reporting deadlines, and program results.
* Maintain relationships with clinical, research, funding, and community partners.
* Ensure appropriately qualified professionals provide clinical services.

**Transportation**
------------------

* Supervise the Fleet Supervisor and oversee transportation services supporting Aging and Disability programs.
* Monitor driver coverage, scheduling, vehicle availability, service concerns, and coordination with program staff.
* Provide oversight of the transportation program to ensure vehicle maintenance, repairs, inspections, and staff training are tracked and addressed.
* Review missed or delayed trips, transportation incidents, and participant concerns.
* Monitor transportation expenses and service needs with Finance and program leadership.

**Quality Documentation and Community Relationships**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Ensure programs follow applicable requirements, contracts, grant conditions, and UCC policies.
* Maintain processes for reviewing records, reports, incidents, complaints, and corrective actions.
* Ensure reports to funders, government agencies, partners, and UCC leadership are accurate and submitted on time.
* Protect participant, resident, employee, and organizational confidentiality.
* Represent UCC at community meetings and maintain productive relationships with participants, caregivers, funders, vendors, and partner organizations.
* Work with Fund Development and other UCC departments on funding opportunities, reporting, and program communication.
* **Perform other duties as assigned.**

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Ability to lead multiple programs and supervise managers, supervisors, and direct-service staff.
* Ability to understand budgets and financial reports and address financial concerns.
* Strong planning, organization, delegation, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.
* Clear and professional verbal and written communication.
* Ability to address staff concerns, provide constructive feedback, and maintain accountability.
* Ability to build effective relationships with older adults, adults with disabilities, caregivers, staff, and community partners.
* Knowledge of person-centered services and culturally responsive programming.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and program data systems.
* Ability to handle confidential information, use sound judgment, and remain calm during difficult situations.

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, Human Services, Gerontology, Healthcare Administration, Public Administration, or a related field.

* Experience serving older adults or adults with disabilities.
* Experience managing budgets, reviewing financial performance, and overseeing reporting requirements.
* Experience working with grants, contracts, community partners, and multiple program areas preferred.
* Fluent in English and Spanish required.
* Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
* Access to reliable transportation for program visits and work-related meetings. Employees using a personal vehicle for work must maintain a valid driver’s license and the vehicle must be insured.

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

Work may be performed in a variety of settings with varying levels of cleanliness, noise, sitting, standing, walking, squatting, bending, lifting and carrying over 50 lbs., pushing, pulling, dragging, and going up and down stairs. Title: Senior Manager, Inside Delivery
Description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

#### **What you'll do**

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

* Creating a strategic roadmap and services architecture for how Scout Motors will sell and transact new and used vehicles to retail customers, from purchase through delivery.
* Supporting and driving the definition and design of the ideal transaction process from an operational perspective (documentation, information flows, and third-party integrations).
* Leading vehicle registration compliance efforts across all active and future sales markets, including program build-out, process design, and cross-functional enablement.
* Developing and documenting comprehensive knowledge of vehicle sales and registration requirements across all states, counties, and localities.
* Designing and operationalizing transaction and delivery workflows and an efficient operating model that ensures a scalable, reliable, customer-centric experience.
* Partnering closely with product managers and engineers to translate operational needs into requirements, prioritize improvements, and develop scalable tools and vendor integrations for end-to-end vehicle sales transactions and deliveries, including documentation, payments, financing, registration, and delivery readiness.
* Leading the operational implementation of AI and automation across the transaction and delivery journey, identifying practical use cases that reduce manual work, improve document accuracy, and help customers complete their purchase and prepare for delivery.
* Owning business testing, rollout, and team adoption of new tools, with clear escalation paths and appropriate human review; measuring impact on transaction completion time, accuracy, team productivity, and the customer experience to guide ongoing improvements.
* Creating a technical support model for sales transaction workflows and operating models.
* Coordinating with Finance to define and build systems that accurately recognize vehicle revenue, ensuring alignment between operations and financial reporting.
* Participating in vendor evaluations and providing operational insight for standard operating procedures, transaction policies, and retail training.

* Collaborative mindset and ability to bring together both internal and external teams behind a common vision; skillful at organizational navigation and cross-functional collaboration at all levels; ability to develop effective partnerships and relationships.
* High agency with capability to independently solve problems and develop strategic, sustainable solutions.

#### **What you'll gain**

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. Title: VP, Operations & Patient Experience
Description:
**About Us**

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company — it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

**About the Role**

The VP, Operations & Patient Experience leads the teams that deliver care and support to every LifeMD patient. The role oversees about 150 people across clinical support operations (medical assistants, scheduling and clinical program management), the patient care center (customer service, care navigation, sales and quality assurance), and the operations function that keeps the business running (program management, procurement and inventory).

The VP serves as the central hub connecting every part of the business to the patient. Delivering high-quality care depends on ongoing collaboration with marketing, technology, finance, pharmacy and LifeMD's affiliated medical group: aligning patient support capacity with marketing's acquisition and retention plans, shaping the product and technology roadmap around what patients and care teams need, partnering with finance on budgets, KPIs and unit economics, and working with pharmacy and providers so every patient's care, from visit to medication, is seamless.

This is a hands-on operating role for a leader who has run clinical operations at scale. In the coming year, the priorities are using AI and automation to raise productivity across patient support, optimizing every patient touchpoint from onboarding through ongoing care, and lowering the cost of serving each patient.

**Responsibilities**

**Cross-functional Partnership**

* Act as the operational hub between patient-facing teams and the rest of the business, so decisions across every function account for their impact on patient care.
* Partner with marketing on demand forecasts, launches and retention programs, so staffing and support are ready for every patient.
* Partner with technology and product to prioritize platform, workflow and AI improvements based on what patients and care teams need.
* Partner with finance on budgets, operational KPIs and unit economics.
* Partner with LifeMD's pharmacy on fulfillment, shipping and refills, so patients receive their medications reliably and on time.
* Partner with LifeMD's affiliated medical group (PC) on clinical workflows, quality and handoffs between providers and care teams, so care delivery and patient support work as one.

**Clinical Operations**

* Lead clinical support operations, including medical assistants, scheduling and clinical program management.
* Partner with medical group leadership on provider capacity, utilization and coverage across sync and async care.
* Manage clinical vendor relationships, contracts and transitions.

**AI and Automation**

* Lead the adoption of AI and automation across patient support and clinical workflows, including AI agents in the patient care center.
* Measure the impact of each deployment on productivity, quality and cost.

**Cost and Unit Economics**

* Own the operations budget and deliver against annual cost targets.
* Drive down the cost of serving each patient through workforce planning, productivity standards and vendor rationalization.
* Set and report operational KPIs in partnership with finance.

**Patient Care Center and Experience**

* Set the strategy and direction for the patient care center (customer service, care navigation, sales and quality assurance), working through its senior director and director, who lead the teams day to day.
* Own patient experience metrics such as resolution, response times and satisfaction, and partner with the business GMs on the on-therapy patient experience.

**Operations and Program Management**

* Run the program management office for cross-functional initiatives, keeping work on schedule and surfacing bottlenecks early.
* Oversee procurement and inventory.

**Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of directors and senior managers, building a strong leadership bench.
* Represent operations and patient experience with the executive team and with external vendors and partners.

  
**Requirements**  

* 10+ years of operations experience, including 5+ years leading multi-layer operations teams (leaders of managers) with large hourly or clinical support workforces.
* Senior leadership experience in healthcare clinical operations, ideally in virtual care, telehealth or a multi-state provider group.
* Hands-on experience deploying AI or automation in operations, with measurable results.
* Proven cost discipline: has owned a large operating budget and reduced costs without sacrificing quality or patient experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executive and board audiences.

**Preferred**

* A clinical background, such as RN, NP or PA, or a clinical operations leadership track.
* Experience leading a contact center at scale.
* Familiarity with multi-state licensing and the regulatory environment for virtual care.

  
**Benefits**  

* Salary: $200,000-250,000 + 15% bonus
* Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
* Retirement Plan (401k, Roth 401k)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays

Title: Senior Manager, Robot Operations
Description:
**About the Role**
------------------

As **Senior Manager, Robot Operations**, you will lead the day-to-day execution of Dot's autonomous delivery operations in the Phoenix area, ensuring safe, reliable, high-quality, and cost-efficient performance. You will own operational outcomes across fleet availability, productivity, service quality, and unit economics while building the processes and frontline capabilities required to scale commercial operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of commercial execution and robotics R&D. Beyond running daily operations, you will partner closely with Engineering and Product teams to translate field observations, operational data, and recurring robot issues into actionable feedback that improves robot performance and reliability. You will establish a culture of ownership, operational discipline, and continuous improvement—ensuring that commercial operations deliver for customers today while accelerating the development of better robots for tomorrow.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Execute Commercial Operations:** Own daily operations in Phoenix, ensuring consistent execution across robot deployment, dispatch, delivery completion, fleet readiness, and field support.
* **Drive Operational Performance:** Deliver against key metrics for safety, availability, productivity, delivery quality, reliability, customer experience, and cost per delivery.
* **Build Operational Discipline:** Establish and continuously improve SOPs, daily operating rhythms, performance reviews, escalation mechanisms, and frontline accountability.
* **Optimize Fleet Performance:** Monitor robot health, utilization, downtime, intervention rates, and mission success; identify bottlenecks and drive corrective actions.
* **Own Cost and Productivity:** Optimize staffing, fleet utilization, field support, maintenance, and other operating expenses to improve unit economics without compromising safety or quality.
* **Lead Frontline Teams:** Build, coach, and develop a high-performing operations team; establish clear ownership, performance expectations, and a culture of hands-on execution.
* **Support R&D Operations:** Partner with Engineering, Product, Autonomy, Hardware, and Remote Assistance teams to support field testing, software releases, hardware validation, and operational experiments.
* **Build the Engineering Feedback Loop:** Systematically capture field issues, categorize failure modes, quantify operational impact, and drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions with Engineering and Product.
* **Improve Robot Reliability:** Use operational data and frontline observations to identify recurring failures, reduce human interventions, improve mean time to recovery, and increase successful autonomous mission completion.
* **Manage Operational Readiness:** Ensure robots, people, processes, and infrastructure are ready for new releases, experiments, and changes to commercial operations.
* **Own Incident Response:** Lead operational escalations, coordinate incident resolution, ensure timely communication, and drive lessons learned into preventive actions.
* **Scale What Works:** Develop repeatable operating mechanisms and best practices that can be standardized and replicated across future markets.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* 8+ years of experience in operations leadership across logistics, mobility, robotics, last-mile delivery, fleet operations, or other complex, asset-intensive environments.
* Demonstrated success leading hands-on, day-to-day operations with accountability for service delivery, operational quality, reliability, and cost.
* Experience operating autonomous robots, autonomous vehicles.
* Strong track record of building operational discipline, improving productivity, and delivering measurable performance improvements.
* Experience managing frontline teams, workforce planning, operational processes, and performance management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use operational data to identify trends, diagnose issues, and drive corrective actions.
* Ability to work closely with technical teams to translate field problems into structured engineering feedback and measurable product improvements.
* Demonstrated ownership, urgency, and sound judgment in dynamic environments where priorities can change quickly.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive issues to resolution.
* Willingness to be present in the field, engage directly with frontline teams, and personally troubleshoot operational challenges.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience launching, scaling, or optimizing commercial delivery or fleet operations.
* Familiarity with remote assistance, robot telemetry, fleet management systems, hardware diagnostics, and autonomy-related workflows.
* Experience supporting R&D, field testing, product launches, and engineering validation in live operating environments.
* Experience building structured incident management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement programs.
* Familiarity with SQL, BI dashboards, and data-driven operational performance management.
* Experience improving unit economics through fleet utilization, labor productivity, maintenance optimization, and process standardization.

**Why This Role**
-----------------

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of autonomous delivery by operating at the intersection of **commercial execution and robotics innovation**. You will own the real-world performance of Dot in Phoenix, ensuring that every day of operations delivers better reliability, stronger customer experiences, and improving unit economics.

You will also play a critical role in making our robots better. By connecting field execution with Engineering and Product, you will help transform operational challenges into product improvements and accelerate the path from R&D to scalable commercial deployment.

**We are looking for a hands-on operator who delivers results today, solves problems at their root, and builds the operational foundation for tomorrow's scale.**

For part-time roles, salaries are adjusted according to scheduled hours. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in Maple Leaf’s annual short-term incentive plan.  
  
**Snapshot of a Day-in-the-Life:**

* **Partner to Identify Capability Gaps:** Partner with Operations leaders, Plant Managers, HRBPs and functional teams (FSQA, Health & Safety, Operational Excellence, Engineering) to identify capability gaps and translate business priorities into practical learning strategies.
* **Design Blended Learning:** Design and develop practical, role-relevant, blended learning (classroom, virtual, digital, on-the-job), including facilitator guides, job aids and assessments. Partner with SMEs to turn technical content into clear learning experiences.
* **Strengthen Onboarding and Talent Development:** Strengthen onboarding, job-specific, cross-training and qualification pathways to accelerate time-to-productivity and improve consistency across sites.
* **Build the Leadership Pipeline:** Design and execute an Operations Leadership Accelerator program that builds frontline and operations leadership capability and grows Maple Leaf Foods’ internal leadership pipeline.
* **Reinforce Safety and Operational Excellence:** Build learning and tools that reinforce safety expectations and leader accountability (Safety Promise, Zero Hero) and bring Operational Excellence priorities to plant teams.
* **Deliver and Coach:** Deliver programs and coach internal facilitators, trainers, supervisors and plant leaders to make new ways of working part of everyday routines and coaching conversations.
* **Measure and Improve:** Evaluate and improve programs using people and learning data, feedback and operational results.
* **Manage Learning Systems and Vendors:** Manage learning systems, digital tools and external vendors to keep content current and scalable.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Build trusted relationships across plants and functions, influence without authority, and travel to sites as required to support delivery.

 **Qualifications**

**What You’ll Bring:**

* **Proven Leadership in Learning:** Proven and recurring success at the Manager level leading learning and development, organizational development or change enablement, ideally supporting manufacturing, food processing, CPG or a similarly complex frontline environment.
* **Learning Expertise:** Strong knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, facilitation, evaluation and behaviour change, with the ability to build programs for onboarding, technical capability, safety culture and frontline leadership.
* **Manufacturing Acumen:** Understanding of manufacturing environments, including safety, quality, standard work and plant performance. Lean, Operational Excellence or continuous improvement experience is an asset.
* **Translating Strategy into Learning:** Ability to translate strategy, operational requirements and technical content into practical learning, with strong facilitation and communication skills that engage operational audiences.
* **Stakeholder Management and Influence:** Strong stakeholder management, consulting and influencing skills across levels.
* **Project Management:** Strong project management skills to manage multiple priorities and vendors in a fast-paced environment.
* **Data-Driven Change Leadership:** Curious change leader who is comfortable working with technologies (LMS/LXP, Microsoft 365, analytics) and using data to drive decisions.

 **Additional Information**

**What We Offer at Maple Leaf Foods:**

* Being part of a high-performance, people-focused company that has an inspiring and unique vision to become the most sustainable protein company on earth, and a deep commitment to sustainable protein across North America.
* An inclusive company culture and a work environment that keeps our people safe, rewards excellence, and empowers everyone to learn and contribute their best.
